A small vegetable garden beside the hut bears a few rows of corn, a smattering of cabbages, and a robust collection of weeds.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest, up
title: [Muddy Village, Commons]
29060.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A repurposed captain's chair sits upon a raised platform near the back of the hut.  Smaller chairs, a few barstools, and some woven grass mats are placed on the ground before it.  A large firepit, blackened with use, is positioned beneath an opening in the conical, white canvas roof.  A large, feather-stuffed mattress encased in patched sailcloth rests against a decoratively adorned side wall.
title: [Village, Chieftain's Hut]
29061.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An orderly arrangement of mismatched planks is supported on either side by two carved wooden figureheads set securely into the soil.  One of the busty maidens has deep blue, long-lashed, painted eyes and draping tresses of faded black hair; the other is more weathered, with only some peeling red paint where her locks used to be.  Upon the makeshift altar, bundles of herbs lend a fragrant air and rounded, glossy black stones surround candles set within bone-inset holders.
title: [Muddy Village, Altar]
29062.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Devoid of vegetation, the ground has been cleared surrounding a modest hut in the center of the space.  Its walls are a collection of mismatched lengths of planking, and its roof consists of a flat sheet of rusted metal.  Tiny clay pots flank the simple doorway, each brimming with a carefully tended collection of weeds.
title: [Muddy Village, Commons]
29063.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Though the interior of this modest hut is sparse, the surfaces are clean and the mud floor is blanketed with a soft layer of straw.  Four woven mats are raised up on planks with stilted legs, each covered with a relatively clean swatch of fabric.  A few broken pots and an upturned brass bell hold a layer of soil and some fragrant, blooming herbs.
title: [Village, Modest Hut]
29064.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Deep holes lay in wait across the narrow pathway, their muddy margins slick with green and black slime.  The top of one abandoned leather boot peeks over the lip of one deep depression.  A set of humanoid footprints, one booted, one bare, fades away farther down the path.  An enclosing wall of briars surrounds the site, while verdant vines drape down from the treetops above, as if to offer aid to those entrapped in the sucking mud.
title: [Muddy Village, Pathway]
29065.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Inside the tall boundary of impenetrable briars enclosing the village, a makeshift fence of lashed conifer boughs surrounds a simple stick and vine hut.  Panels of green and yellow canvas have been nailed across the doorway, and the roof and walls are fashioned from sawed-off saplings, bound with lengths of twisted vines.  A mound of discarded food scraps nearby draws the attention of a few scavenging rodents.
title: [Muddy Village, Commons]
29066.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Simple layers of sticks, bound by dried vines, form the roof and sides of this small structure.  A circle of charred rocks provides a safe space for fires and a few grass and reed mats draped in soiled canvas provide mud-free spots for bedding down.  Scattered shoes, most one-of-a-kind, are lined up beside the entry.
title: [Village, Stick and Vine Hut]
29067.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tucked away from the rest of the village, one dilapidated hut sits close to Widowmaker's Road, which passes to the south.  Sounds filter in from travelers on the road, making this a less than desirable spot for a homestead.  Some overgrown weeds have invaded the doorless entry of the simple mud and stick abode, and tracks of animals leading to and from the structure suggest it is not completely abandoned.
title: [Muddy Village, Commons]
29068.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: One mildewed and moth-eaten bedroll is the lone remnant of furnishings in this ramshackle hut.  Animal droppings litter the floor, and tufts of fur and feathers billow lightly with each incoming breeze.  Several fluffy bits of multicolored fur and a few downy feathers have been utilized for a collection of rodent nests along the back wall.
title: [Village, Dilapidated Hut]
29069.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A mound of debris covers much of the soggy ground, topped with a faded hand-lettered sign.  Pathways along the circumference of the mound mark the route taken by previous passersby.  Tangled vines and thorny brambles form an encircling barrier around the space.
title: [Muddy Village, Dump]
29070.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Overgrown brush leaves only a narrow footpath upon which to travel.  To the north, a wall of tangled briars, several feet thick, blocks further passage, although breaks in the branching briars allow a view of Kraken's Fall and its surroundings.  Vines creeping along the boggy ground seem determined to trip any who relax their vigilance as they pass.  Clusters of wildflowers lend an incongruent cheeriness to the otherwise dreary environs.
title: [Muddy Village, Overlook]
29071.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Low hanging vines, their sharp needles threatening harm to any who approach, drape downward to engulf the tops of some low, spindly shrubs.  Partially consumed by the voracious vines, a simple mud-walled hut cowers amid the encroaching greenery.  A large, fallen bird's nest lays broken on the ground, bits of shattered eggshells and a few tiny feathers stuck between the twigs and grass around them.
title: [Muddy Village, Commons]
29072.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Few niceties adorn this simple, mud-walled hut.  Woven mats on the ground would seem to barely keep one up out of the muck, and a charred circle of rocks is utilitarian at best.  Scattered pots and dirty utensils rest on the damp, earthen floor, their unwashed surfaces caked in dried food and debris.  Swarms of insects provide music for the home, buzzing in and out of the open doorway both day and night.
title: [Village, Mud Hut]
29073.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wooden planks provide drier walkways above the muddy ground.  Workstations are spaced about the area, some with wooden tanning racks drying pelts of foxes and hares, others with makeshift benches topped with rusty hammers, saws, and collections of nails.  Patches of moonlight stream randomly from above in this otherwise shadowed area beneath the trees.
title: [Muddy Village, Workspace]
29074.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Much of the area has been cleared of vegetation, its muddy ground a mixture of wet dirt, coarse sand, and slick clay.  Interspersed with a few sparse tufts of dead grasses, tracks from foxes, raccoons, and a host of small rodents crisscross the muddy ground.  One tall, yellow sunflower, its head brimming with tiny black seeds, stands sentinel over the area, the lone splash of color in this othrerwise dreary space.
title: [Muddy Village, Pathway]
29075.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Waist-high grasses obscure the narrow pathways, their waving green seedheads bulging with future generations.  Thick vines enclose the surrounding vegetation, encircling the perimeter of this small, impoverished village.  The open, grassy area is one of the few spaces enjoying the silvery bath of moonlight from the open skies above.
title: [Muddy Village, Grassy Knoll]
29076.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Pale grey rock lines the walls, ceiling, and floor in this tight space.  Sunight from the southeast filters in from the entrance, but its rays reach no further than halfway down the narrow tunnel.  A slight rut has been worn away down the middle, showing where the passing of many feet has eroded the surface of the floor.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
29077.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rivulets of icy-cold water dribble down the angled rocks walls to form shallow, standing pools along the sides of the tunnel.  An abundance of hornwort carpets the damp space, its elongated, horn-like sporophytes reaching upwards as though trying to escape.  Wafts of fresh air deliver the occasional fragrance of the nearby woodlands and the faint scent of sea air.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
29080.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A sandy coating carpets the floor of the tunnel where crumbling walls have strewn their particulate debris.  Claw-tipped footprints crisscross the floor with long swaths between them marking the dragging of a tail.  A protrusion of roots from the world above has infiltrated through cracks and fissures in the ceiling.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
29090.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A steady *drip-drip-drip* echoes off of every facet of the surrounding rock walls, lending a near-deafening reverberation to the cramped, enclosed space.  Directly overhead and continuing down one wall, a deep fissure  proves to be the source of the watery incursion.  A spiderweb of cracks spreading from it lend an air of impending danger to this part of the tunnel.
paths: Obvious exits: southwest, northwest, down, out
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
29093.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A stunning backdrop of vertical limestone faces meet with a more substantial, horizontal plane of granite that form this spacious, above-ground terrace.  Rushing water cascades down in a frothy white display of force, pooling across the black granite surface in crystal clear sheets that sparkle with reflections of golden sunlight.  In the distance, the sound of waves against the shore provides a rhythmic melody.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Water Terrace]
29094.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sheer absence of light makes traversing this enclosed tunnel tricky for even the most experienced hunters.  While feeling along the walls could aid in navigation, the coating of mucilaginous slime may dissuade the squeamish from relying upon that method.  Echoes from nearby chambers provide intermittant distractions from the darkness.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
29095.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Jagged rocks and boulders litter the floor, many strewn with the large, shed skins of lizards announcing their status as favored rubbing spots.  A small pool releases steam into the tunnel, making the air quite stifling and almost unbearably hot.  Fresh droppings beside the water lend a noxious odor to the moisture-laden air.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, west
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
29097.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Heat pulses through the thick rock walls, as though the very earth beneath the tunnel is on fire.  Steam escapes in sporadic puffs from cracks and fissures in the floor.  Crackling sounds echo in the surrounding rock, hinting that perhaps one should not linger long in the space.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
29098.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cool air currents waft through the wide tunnel passage, making it a refreshingly pleasant environ compared to other parts of the underground tunnel nearby.  A small pool of clear, cold water draws many visitors, as evidenced by the tracks of skittering crabs and slithering lizards left in the sand beside the water.  Lichen, liverwort, and tiny ferms cling to small cracks and fissure along the pale limestone walls.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
29100.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This open-air terrace juts from the mountain at a dizzying height.  A bird's-eye view of the town of Kraken's Fall spreads out below, its cobblestone streets basking in the warmth of the sun.  The rising and falling swells of the blue-green ocean stretch toward the distant horizon.  The gentle fragrance of the forest below dances lanquidly within the cool mountain breeze.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Sky Terrace]
29109.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Slick with seepage, the walls and floor provide the perfect environs for the proliferation of blue-green hornwort.  Their flattened bases cling to the rocky substrate, while their horn-like protrusions branch upwards, waving as one with any stirring of the oppressively warm air.  Overturned shells of deceased crustaceans collect enough water to support thriving colonies of striped, brown snails.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
29110.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The pale grey walls give the impression of closing in as this portion of the tunnel narrows to form a tightly confined space.  Passage is made more difficult by the presence of fallen rocks, obliterating what once may have been an accessible path.  A tremendous heat generating from the floor and walls makes them almost too hot to touch.  A reddish glow emanates from the edges of a nearby fissure.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
29113.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bursts of molten, orange-red magma bubble up from the center of the ever-expanding terrace.  Once ejected from hidden tubes deep within the earth, the viscous lava flows across the black and crackled surface, adding additional depth to the cooled pathways along the terraced perimeter.  Steam rises in plumes from pockets of cooling crust near a porous lava rock fissure, and a fine-grained ash chokes the air before being wafted away by the incoming sea breezes.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Lava Terrace]
29114.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A narrow cave stream trickles lanquidly across the stone floor.  Roots from unseen flora outside the tunnel have breeched the walls and formed a stable root mat that floats upon the water.  The occasional *pop* of bubbles on the surface reveal the location of hidden amphibians below.  The stifling heat and humidity do little to encourage visitors to linger.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
29116.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Multihued minerals paint the surrounding rock walls in shades of green, yellow, and white.  Colorful crystals, only a few inches high, cling to the stone floor and attempt the mighty climb toward the ceiling.  Skittering noises and the clacking of claws filter in from a deeper part of the tunnel.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
29117.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A substrate of igneous rock supports an earth-covered expanse just beyond the nearby cavern.  An abundance of plant life thrives in the open air.  Delicate ferns and mosses grow in and beside a ragged fissure, while grasses and arboreal specimens proliferate farther out toward the terrace edges.  The salty fragrance of sea air drifts lightly on the occasional breezes.
title: [Hornwort Cavern, Earth Terrace]
29118.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Barely as wide as a human's arm span, the mist-slicked ledge mocks any who try to move swiftly.  Loose pebbles of chert and quartz underfoot prevent a firm footing near the foreboding drop.  The pervasive scent of the sea lends a sharp tang to the winds whipping up from below.
title: [Cliffwalk, Narrow Ledge]
29120.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A series of wrought iron grips, affixed to irregular boulders, provide the only assurance of safety for those brave enough to traverse the steep and rocky terrain.  Fierce ocean winds whip across the exposed cliff face, threatening to send both rocks and travelers into the frothing waves far below.  Flecks of mica imbedded within the white wall of rock reflect specks of brilliant, golden light as the sun passes across the sky.
title: [Cliffwalk, Craggy Descent]
29124.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Deep furrows in the loose gravel underfoot tell the tale of travelers who nearly missed the sharp turnaround.  Just beyond the edge, atop craggy outcroppings below, scattered backpacks and clothing lay among broken shards of shelfae scales and a few sun-bleached bones.  Half-sized pines struggle to maintain a grip in the loose soil of the crevices nearby.
title: [Cliffwalk, Hairpin Turn]
29128.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Two halves of a large, rough-barked pine drape precariously across the trail, threatening to block further passage should they be completely torn asunder at the base of the shattered trunk.  Scorch marks mar the woody pulp of the interior where nodules of amber, glass-like resins have been tempered to a hardened state.  Loose, flat slabs of limestone, cleaved off from the cliff face above, litter the narrow trail.
title: [Cliffwalk, Shattered Tree]
29129.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The treacherous trail hugs closely to the steep and rocky cliffside, making travel for groups a single-file affair.  Shattered shelfae scales lay broken upon the rock-strewn ground, marking the previous passage of hunters over this forbidding terrain.  The incessant pounding of waves far below is but a soft and rhythmic whisper at this height.
title: [Cliffwalk, Narrow Ledge]
29131.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: About midway between the full height of the steep cliff above and the barely visible flatlands below, the trail is reasonably flat and wide through these surroundings.  Openings and outcroppings along the cliff wall provide secure spots where those who are prey can hide and predators can await their chance to ambush.  Relentless winds off the ocean howl loudly across the flat and rock-strewn terrain.
title: [Cliffwalk, Angled Loop]
29133.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Overturned, overlapped, and oversized boulders make passage along the barely discernable path nearly impossible.  Broken and sheared-off surfaces across the cliff face immediately overhead suggest evidence of a recent rockslide.  The crushed skeletal remains of rodents and reptiles lay half-buried in the rubble, indicating not all escaped the path of the falling debris.
title: [Cliffwalk, Rocky Loop]
29134.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A series of cuts gouged into the rockface of the cliff offer a way to climb higher in the rocky terrain.  Piles of loose and crumbling boulders and stones bridge a steep descent towards a lower, and perhaps safer, part of the trail.  Beside the path, only a smattering of vegetation has managed to hold fast to the inhospitable ground.
title: [Cliffwalk, Crumpled Steps]
29217.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sunlight reflects off of the red clay roof tiles atop several buildings in the town below the cliff side trail.  Shoppers scurry through the cobblestone streets, though from this height, most look to be halflings.  The trail, though narrow, is at least more level here than on the craggier faces directly above.

Silvery bands of moonlight reflect off of the red clay roof tiles atop several buildings in the town below the cliff side trail.  A few tavern-goers and late night revelers wander the cobblestone streets, though from this height, most look to be halflings.  The darkened trail, though narrow, is at least more level here than on the craggier faces directly above.
title: [Cliffwalk, Narrow Trail]
29218.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Though only a scattering of sand and loose soil covers the flat stones of this outcropping, a few hardy plants have managed to gain a foothold.  Waving grasses dance in rhythm to the fluctuating breezes, and small, spindly saplings hoist themselves up out of soil-laden crevices to spread their budding greenery.  Upright and overlapped shelfae scales have been fashioned into tiny garden borders around a patch of blooming yellow and pink flowers.
title: [Cliffwalk, Verdant Pass]
29219.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Carved directly into the side of the imposing cliff face is a monolithic sculpture of a reptilian being.  Its features are blurred from wind, rain, and the passage of time, but gangly, claw-tipped forelimbs and a thick, scale-carved tail clearly identify the figure as a native inhabitant of these lands.  Golden reflections undulate off mica flecks imbedded in the rock face, lending a life-like quality to the imposing figure.
title: [Cliffwalk, Narrow Ledge]
29220.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A sheer drop-off punctuates any attempts at travel toward the west, while a narrow, rocky trail funnels off to the east.  Some craggy steps carved into the cliff appear to lead downward toward an open space filled with greenery below.  The cry of gulls echoes nearby, their location obscured by a rising fog from the sea.
title: [Cliffwalk, Narrow Ledge]
29221.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A wide outcropping of flattened stones has accumulated enough sandy soil to support the growth of vegetation.  The verdant ground cover and emerald-leafed saplings stand in stark contrast to the white, vertical face of the bordering cliff.  A heavy mist rides the air currents drifting up from the ocean surface below.
title: [Cliffwalk, Verdant Pass]
29222.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flowering vines tenaciously climb their way across the bordering white cliff face, digging tiny green tendrils into each crevice and crack to gain a secure hold.  Rounded petals of sunburst orange and brilliant red bloom along the length of each vine.  The ocean far below throws angry waves crashing against the shoreline, erupting into a frothy spray before subsiding once again.
title: [Cliffwalk, Verdant Pass]
29223.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Nothing except open air and a precipitous drop lays to the east where the rocky outcropping ends abruptly.  A few scattered scales and bits of bone bear the signs of a battle lost in the form of old, dried, darkened bloodstains.  Frequent gusts of wind whistle eerily as they force their way through large crevices in the rocky landscape.
title: [Cliffwalk, Ragged Outcropping]
29224.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The calls of shopkeepers hawking their wares arises from the town just below this narrow cliffside trail.  Minstrels wander through the visible streetscapes, lending the melodies of instruments and song to the sounds rising from below.  Accompanied by the ceaseless pounding of the ocean waves beyond, the cacophony echoes rhythmically off the surrounding, vertical cliff face.
title: [Cliffwalk, Narrow Trail]
29225.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To the east, only a tangle of downed saplings half-buried in rocky debris marks the end of the narrow trail.  Gaily clad shoppers attired in finery mingle with sailors from the nearby piers, bustling through the busy streets of the town below.  The aroma of roasting meats drifts upward on the rising breeze, seducing the occasional hunter to abandon this harsh and near-barren terrain.
title: [Cliffwalk, Rockslide Alley]
29226.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Deep ruts scored into the mud and heavily trampled grasses are all that remain of what appears to have once been pristine earth.  Circular stumps, some fairly large and others quite small, jut upwards in their severed stances.  A spindly game trail leads toward a road just visible to the south, and several small paths lead off in northerly directions for those venturing deeper into the forest.
title: [Black Weald, Clearcut]
29227.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Far enough from the road to bring the respite of silence, this wooded glade is peaceful and serene.  A gently rippled pond provides fresh water for the forest dwellers, their hoof and paw prints leading to and from the water's edge.  Fallen logs, half-submerged along the shoreline, grant a safe sunning spot for yellow-bellied terrapins and a few spotted lizards.
title: [Black Weald, Sky Pond]
29228.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A well-trodden pathway leads deeper into the forest to the northeast.  One set of paw prints, as large as a giantkin's hand, are layered atop the tiny hoof prints of a juvenile ungulate.  Thick foliage and brambled patches make the southeast spur appear as a less inviting option.
title: [Black Weald, Spur Road]
29229.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A circle of severed stumps dominates the landscape, with only some spindly saplings and ground-hugging shrubs lending traces of greenery to the space.  The average diameter of the stumps is over four feet, indicating true giants were felled here.  Overhead, a few semi-wilted vines drape from the narrow-trunked, immature trees along the perimeter.
title: [Black Weald, Clearcut]
29230.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dense forest growth along this western edge of the weald obscures all but a few narrow beams of golden sunlight from above.  An ancient sycamore proclaims itself ruler of this space, its six-foot diameter and tall, spreading crown keeping all but the hardiest of saplings from reaching for the sky.  A scattering of shed antlers marks this as a gathering place for herds of large ungulate natives of Kraken's Fall.
title: [Black Weald, Western Aspect]
29231.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A riot of color greets those who reach this secluded meadow.  Reaching heights of one to two meters, cheery stalks of larkspur decorate the fertile ground.  Blossoms of blue and pink grow in abundance, with a smattering of purple and white lending variety to the scene.  Peeking through the blossoms is a verdant backdrop of foliage, with broad leaves divided into deep lobes.
title: [Black Weald, Larkspur Meadow]
29232.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Scorched and disfigured trunks hold fast to their long-claimed patches of ground along the western edge of the weald.  Many of their past compatriots lay spawled across the earth, their scarred lengths felled by the forces of lightning strikes, fire, or wind.  A few young oaks, maples, and yews struggle to gain a foothold in the harsh, unforgiving terrain.
title: [Black Weald, Western Aspect]
29233.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A refreshing coolness pervades the air across this tiny glade, provided by the dense ceiling of foliage overhead.  An aromatic blend of moisture-laden leaf matter, resinous pine sap, and rich, loamy soil permeates the space with an organic and earthy fragrance.  Thick foliage and patches of thorny brambles mark the uninviting passage to the northwest.
title: [Black Weald, Shadowed Glade]
29234.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Heavily trampled dirt makes for a dry and dusty road running between Widowmaker's Road and the depths of the forest beyond.  The shed antlers of several large stags are bleached white with age, and a massive skull of ursian origin rests half-buried beneath a fallen oak.  The lilt of songbirds lend a chorus to the caws of ravens overhead.
title: [Black Weald, Spur Road]
29235.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The pathway narrows here with the peripheral encroachment of gnarled hardwoods draped in vines.  Little light pierces the canopy above, with only narrow beams of sunlight reaching the shrub-tangled forest floor.  The entwined aromas of stale urine and fresh dung permeate the still air, threatening to precipitate a bout of nausea for those with delicate tummies.
title: [Black Weald, Game Trail]
29236.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The narrow and circuitous route rings the edges of the deeper, darker forest land.  To one side maples, elm, and hickory rise up in an intimidating wall to the interior.  To the other side, a steep cliff falls away along the back side of the island, presenting a precipitous drop to the ocean far below.  Small animal tracks can be glimpsed underfoot, partially hidden by the waist-high grasses.
title: [Black Weald, Game Trail]
29237.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Evenly spaced rows of ancient spruce dominate this stretch of forest.  Like soldiers reporting for duty, each stands tall and straight beside its neighbor, bending little even when faced with buffeting winds.  Closely spaced needles cling to sturdy branches and thin, smooth-barked cones hang precariously high in each treetop.
title: [Black Weald, Softwood Stretch]
29238.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Stands of immature firs, spreading hemlocks, and stately pines are staggered throughout the open space.  A carpet of browning needles cushions the ground underfoot, and the husks of deceased beetles lend an iridescence to many of the standing trunks.  Downward draping boughs lightly kiss the tops of the waving grasses at their feet.
title: [Black Weald, Softwood Stretch]
29239.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A mixture of hardwoods and softwoods intermingles with verdant shrubs, thorn-laden vines, and a few hardy grasses.  Denuded stripes of yellow pulp deface the stately trunks where the antlers of large stags have stripped away swaths of protective bark.  Game trails crisscross the area, leading to and from the deeper forest.

A crisp, freshly painted number five in navy blue dominates the central planks, which show recent signs of scrubbing.  Bronze and brass-hitching cleats stand at the ready to serve those that seek portage.
title: [Comyner's Docks, Pier 4]
32924.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Knotted hemp is fed through a series of thick pilings to create a functional railing that is interrupted by wide spaces where hitch cleats are arranged for vessels to tie up to. title: [Comyner's Docks, Pier 5]
32925.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crates and barrels occupy one section of the pier; the piles are tidily stacked and bound together by small-weave hempen fishing nets and tied to the nearest piling. title: [Comyner's Docks, Pier 5]
32926.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Coils of rope lay in tidy bundles upon the decking of the pier, their weight, lengths, and hues varying from thick to thin, short to long, and dusky grey to sun-bleached white.  Polished copper and bronze cleats, tarnished with verdigris due to the salt water, are wrapped with hitching leads that dangle in the water.

32929.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Roughly triangular in shape, the Imperial Post widens at the back, providing ample room behind the counter for the storing of mail and letters awaiting sorting.  A polished lebbek wood sign hangs on one terracotta-accented wall, next to an elaborate mural of Brisker's Cove.  Pots of bright pink muhly grass cluster around a vase of fresh-cut flowers, adding splashes of brightness to the otherwise pristine white-and-terracotta decor.
title: [Imperial Post]
32936.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Stacks of curing wood line the southern walls, each arranged in racks by type and labeled with concisely worded phrases etched into copper plates.  Upon the northern wall, tools of the coopering craft are carefully fitted into displays amid glass-faced bins holding quarter hoops, head hoops, and rivets.  Several worktables house barrels in various stages of creation, though no attendants are visibly working on them at this time.  A small door leads to the backyard.
title: [Cooperage, Workroom]
32937.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Backed by a stockade fence, the small, packed-dirt yard is devoid of any kind of growth.  Barrels with copper, iron, or bronze hoops are stacked in three of the space's four corners, while the fourth holds an old trough of discarded materials.  The sound of hammering filters through the air, issuing from within the connecting warehouse.
title: [Cooperage, Courtyard]
32938.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Neatly arranged rows of boxes stacked upon each other against the walls display an assortment of styled hats, along with tiny plaques etched with prices in silvers.  An order counter at the back of the shop is shrouded in a haze of tobacco smoke, where a petite woman with a gem-adorned headband shrewdly gazes at everyone who enters.
title: [Harborside Haberdashery]
32939.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Heavy boards are hammered over the support beams of the shop's haphazardly furbished walls, nearly unsuitable to support the weight of the unlit, ornate copper sconces affixed to them.  Cloaks, capes, and jackets hang from pegs jutting from a pair of freestanding wooden poles to either side of an ironwood order counter.  Standing attentive behind the counter is a balding human man wearing lavish crimson silks and dark leathers.
title: [Unfinished Fashion]
32940.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A jovial woman patiently assists patrons in this freestanding pavilion, hawking wares strewn over makeshift tables and counters.  From the eastern corner of the roped-off displays and arching overhead to the west is a massive, artfully crafted coral and sea glass dolphin of enormous proportions.  The fins of the dolphin extend outward and provide a sheltered area beneath them.
title: [Niima's Embrace]
32941.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rough wooden timbers form the walls of this small shop, lengths of braided cord tethered from one side to another.  Dangling from the cords, a selection of colorful kaftans, pantaloons, and burnooses sway gently as a coastal breeze pushes its way through the entrance.  A tall copper-framed mirror is affixed to the wall adjacent to a small pedestal near a wooden order counter, where a young rosy-cheeked woman stands attentively.
title: [The Tailor's Sister]
32942.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Pin-tailed sandgrouse warble to one another as they wander within and out of the shade provided by yellow-flowered gopher plants that grow in scattered profusion amid the bright white stones of the garden.  A singular path trails between the cobblestones of Trisister Road and a small shrine of white marble.  Lining the ambling way, small succulents of coral-edged green, crimson, and russet hues provide a splash of interest against the smooth stones.
title: [Shrine of Fate, Garden]
32943.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cool marble slabs stretch across the circular floor of the shrine, the alabaster hue fairly luminous in the sunlight that slips through the surrounding pillars.  At the heart of the structure is a decorative altar, long and wide; its smooth surface is rather plain while its sides are carved with basrelief images.  A trinity of statues, each a different female Artkati, stands between the pillars.
title: [Shrine of Fate, Oratory]
32944.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Surrounded by carved columns, an altar rests at the center of a small shrine with a domed ceiling.  Cold air radiates from the smooth surface of the altar, veins of gold, cobalt blue, and sea green spiderwebbing across it only to disappear beyond the edges.  A quiet hum fills the air.
title: [Shrine of Fate, Altar]
32945.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Winding its way through thick pink muhly grasses that transition to clusters of fountain grass, a winding path connects the cobbled streets of Brisker's Cove to the cliff's edge of the promontory.  Distant sounds of lapping waves fill the air, while a subtle coastal breeze sets the surrounding grasses to waving.
title: [Promontory of the Shield, Path]
32946.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A sizeable wooden wheel is displayed against the wall of the office, the helm's surface carved in elaborate nautical imagery and coated in dark lacquer.  Several gold-framed maps line the planked walls, each one depicting various trade routes through the surrounding waters of the Great Western Sea and beyond.  A worn leather-backed chair sits behind a kraken-carved desk of driftwood, the surface cluttered with various bottles glinting as the moonlight peeks through the tall windows.
title: [Harbormaster's Office]
32947.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Waves crash upon the lower cliffs of the promontory, flooding porous rock and creating an echoing sound reminiscent of a flute being placed underwater.  Fountain grass frames the bare granite and creates a natural barrier that prevents access to the cliff's edge.  A stoic sentinel, a towering alabaster statue representing a warrior with his hands resting on a shield planted at his feet, gazes eastward.
title: [Promontory of the Shield, Bluff]
32948.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crowded but tidy, the customs house is home to many official services within the Comyner's Ward.  Stacks of crates and boxes waiting to be inspected have labels of lading attached to their faces, the inked markings nothing more than chicken scratch and patterns of repeating numbers.  A small accounting booth occupies one wall, a bored teller sitting behind its protective bars.
title: [Imperial Counting House, Entry]
33748.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dimly lit and cramped, the small hallway is stifling and warm.  Very little airflow makes its way through the passage as crates and boxes fill the eastern wall from floor to ceiling.  Illuminated from within, a small exchange booth houses a sleepy clerk.
title: [Imperial County House, Exchange]
33749.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Smoking lanterns hang from hooks in the ceiling, their glass faces stained with soot and grim.  Separations in the clapboard walls allow the winds from the nearby coastline to sweep sand into the cramped hallway, creating a heavy patina of dust and grit that touches every surface.  Squinting through the bars of a small collections booth, a clerk decorated in spectacles watches the hallway with interest.
title: [Imperial County House, Debts]
33750.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Serving as a bridge between the flotilla proper and the docking system, this large overlook is made of reclaimed ships' woods and thick ropes of rolled hemp.  Nestled against the side of the flotilla are two small shops, a rickety shack and a small battered tent, and a large sign covered in warnings is prominently displayed next to a broken anchor.
title: [Twisted Tentacle Overlook]
33051.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Five crooked piers float haphazardly along the outer edge of the flotilla, a series of ropes and pulleys hanging at the ready to collapse the docking system at a moment's notice for rapid travel.  The uneven decks are comprised of dozens of types of wood, most resembling salvage from ships' hulls, and some ragged bits of cork serve as minimal padding at each docking slip.  A battered sign reads, "Maelstrom Pier - Slips 1-5," and a whirlpool sucking a ship into its depths is carved into it.

description: The main deck of the flotilla is expansive, its sturdy flooring intentionally scuffed to reduce falling accidents, and the outer edges are built up in a protective composite of ships, sails, metalwork, and weaponry.  A giant opening at the center of the flotilla drops into the ocean below, a rickety railing with a series of painted buoys serving as a very slight deterrent to taking a plunge.
title: [The Great Piratical Flotilla]
33074.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Elaborate systems of colorful sails and powerful weaponry line the outer edge of the flotilla's deck, making it hard to see the ocean from here.  The stern of an incongruous river boat has been permanently lashed to the flotilla, its once bright paint faded and chipped and its paddle wheel nailed solidly to the deck.
title: [Flotilla, Kraken's Corner]
33075.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several canvas awnings provide protection from the elements, while a few cannons affixed to the outer deck provide protection from more intelligent threats, their polished barrels glinting in the moonlight.  Almost blocking movement easterly, dozens of crates are stacked high and covered in thick hempen netting weighted with glaes spheres.  A narrow path between the stacks is made more treacherous by the addition of patches of seaweed, barnacles, and the occasional misplaced cannonball.
title: [Flotilla, The Stacks]
33076.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Ocean water churns below, taking up a large portion of the flotilla's core.  A rope strung between two unsteady-looking poles is all that separates the denizens of the deck from a plunge, and a series of painted buoys has been wrapped around one pole for rescue purposes.  The deck here has deep score marks that look a bit too uneven to be from moving crates and are deepest right next to the edge of the pool.
title: [Flotilla, Mermaid's Plunge]
33077.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The outer edges of the flotilla are built up high here, with a reinforced archway leading to a dock system to the northwest and a small passage opening to the southwest between berthed ships and permanent protections.  The deck sprawls wide, leaving ample room for maneuvering, and a river boat is securely lashed across the south edge.  Intricately carved into the deck is a sea dragon wrapped about a small ship.
title: [Flotilla, Sea Dragon Quay]
33078.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A kobold and squirrel statue rests next to an ironwood gangway leading to the bow of the Flying Squirrel, and several crates marked "Grog" are stacked on the other side.  Moonlight glints off the waves below.  Numerous ships crowd some of the docking berths while others are repurposed as defense bays, lined with cannons and large barrels stained with pitch.  The bow of a river boat is securely affixed to the flotilla.
title: [Flotilla, Sea Kobold's Folly]
33079.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Built up defenses along the outer edge of the flotilla cast twisting shadows across the wide expanse of moonlit deck.  Several empty bottles line up near the docking slip for a derelict carrack listing heavily to port, and a series of painted buoys dangles near the open waters at the flotilla's center.  At the center of the deck is a whimsical sea glass inlay depicting a drowned moose snuggling with a siren.

Red grasses peek up through the banks of snow, lending splashes of vibrant color to the monochrome of the highland landscape.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Trail]
35005.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sheer and sharp, cliffs of black volcanic stone rise over the southern beaches of the island.  Though severe, the cliffs are far from lifeless.  Tufts of hardy red tundra grass grow in profusion near a narrow path that plummets steeply toward the shores below.  Nesting birds, from murres to auklets, make their nests in cracks and crevices in the natural stone walls, and their droppings have stained the rock white in places, like splatters of paint on a huge canvas.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Trail]
35006.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The trailway comes to an end at the base of the sheer black cliffs overlooking the beach.  A narrow path ascends through a break in the cliffs, offering a steep ascent to the clifftops.  Bird nests crowd every nook and cranny in the rock face, their occupants filling the air with shrill cries and song.
title: [Grim Sands, Cliff Base]
35007.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Hardy grasses sprout along the edges of the icy ebon cliffs, protruding roots shivering in the cold wind.  The roar of the surf echoes up the flat cliff faces to either side of the narrow promontory, amplified into a thunderous rumble that ebbs and flows with the crashing tide.  A ribbon of well-trodden path strikes through the whipping tundra grasses.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Promontory]
35008.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The promontory broadens toward its southernmost extreme, curling like a crooked finger as it stretches out over the frigid main.  White-capped waves slap at the shores below in rumbling counterpart to the high-pitched cries of seabirds.  To the southeast stands a lighthouse with a dark stone facade, a solitary watcher over the forbidding shores.
title: [Glaoveln, Scrimshaw Cliffs]
35009.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The footpath winds toward the end of the promontory and the edifice that oversees it.  Built from rough-hewn blocks of stone, the lighthouse at the promontory's end is pocked from years of assault from the salt-laden wind.  It looms over the waters far below, a cold monument over a colder shore.
title: [Glaoveln, Scrimshaw Cliffs]
35010.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A small fetish of scrimshawed bones and shark teeth hangs from the lintel of the lighthouse's entry arch.  Relentless ocean winds whistle through gaps between the rounded stones making up the edifice's walls.  Though sparsely furnished, the antechamber is occupied by a winding stone stairway that curves toward the upper story.
title: [Lighthouse, Ground Floor]
35011.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Icy winds whip through the upper chamber of the lighthouse, making the flame burning at its center dance drunkenly.  The smoky glass panes of the windows encircling the chamber permit a dazzling view of the landscape in every direction, from the dark waters of the Frostmain to the rugged landscape further inland.  Fingers of frost glisten from the windows' edges.
title: [Lighthouse, Upper Floor]
35012.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A monument of time-browned ivory stands to the side of the road.  The old scrimshaw illuminating its carved surface still possesses a rich cobalt hue that is unfaded by the passage of sunny days and cruel nights.  It rests in the shadows of short, crooked evergreens, red grasses growing thick at its base.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Monument]
35013.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The beach far below the cliffs narrows to a sliver of dark sand.  Sharp jags of igneous rock breach up through the sand like crooked black fangs.  Even the islands off the shore are cruel expanses of craggy rock, suited for habitation only by barnacles and the occasional sea birds.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Trail]
35014.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The trail veers sharply inland as the bluffs grow unstable, undermined by the ebb and flow of the icy tide with no beach to protect their base.  To either side of the path, tundra grasses grow thick on the tops of earthen humps deposited by the wild wind, looking like colorful tufts of scraggly hair.  Glistening white drifts, the product of recent snows, are scattered across the harsh landscape.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Trail]
35015.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Retreating from the bluffs, the trail widens into a well-trodden road that rises and falls over a series of coastal hills.  Rich, fertile soil has given rise to an abundance of dusty red tundra grasses that ripple and wave in the freezing gale.  Trees dot the landscape, but none are of significant height, for their trunks are stunted by the constant battering of the elements.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Inland Road]
35016.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A few larches and hoarbeams cluster together as if conspiring to break the incessant gale, but they can only charitably be described as a stand of trees.  Yellowing needles scatter over the road.  The trail continues to climb as the briny bite of the sea slowly surrenders to the fresh scents of evergreens and loam.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Inland Road]
35017.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: As it crests a grassy hilltop dotted with snow, the roadway splits at a round black boulder.  The stone is taller than most of the scant trees dotting the landscape.  Eastward the road rambles, widening as it makes a descent toward volcanic flats in the far distance.  A smaller trail winds off to the northwest before it is lost in a small alpine meadow.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Boulder]
35018.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sheltered by a bend in the surrounding hills, the small meadow is a thriving niche of greenery in a cruel and foreboding landscape.  Here and there, patches of snow dot the grasses, but for the most part, the sanctuary is shielded from the fury of the elements.  A small herd of steelhorn roltons take advantage of the sheltered greenery.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Meadow]
35019.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The meadow's southernmost verge provides a dazzling view of the Frostmain.  Dotted with stony islands, the grey expanse of water sprawls out in a frigid panorama that stretches as far as the eye can see.  Contrasted with the tenebrous hues of the sea, the meadow is alive with green grasses and bright flowers in sunny golds and startling violets.
title: [Glaoveln, Scrimshaw Cliffs]
35020.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The road swerves around snowy hills as it slowly descends toward flatland.  Rich volcanic soil has given rise to vegetation as abundant as it is hardy.  Grasses in waves of red and green cascade down the hillsides.  Seemingly heedless of the snow, bright-colored flowers peek their heads out of the groundcover in vivid patches of violet, periwinkle, and fuchsia.  The mountains in the distance are jagged, white-capped, and severe by comparison.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Inland Road]
35021.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ebb and flow of the surf is but a distant whisper, having ceded ground to the music of alpine birdsong and the susurrus of cold wind through the alpine meadows.  Mountains loom in the northeast, the jagged volcanic peaks a study in opposites.  Some are black shadows in the night, but one, taller than the rest, weeps a constant flow of lava as if its peak were an open wound.  Even in the night, it is bathed balefully in the infernal light of its seething lava flows.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Inland Road]
35022.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dipping down between two low hills, the road's constant undulations begin to flatten.  Crippled by a broken wheel, an ash-covered wagon stands abandoned by the roadside, denuded of its contents.  Whatever beasts of burden bore it have been cut free.  Scorch marks riddle the wooden bed.  The wagon has been deserted for long enough that grasses and patches of wildflowers have sprung up within the shelter of its shadow.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Inland Road]
35023.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Warmth lingers over the roadway despite the efforts of the whistling wind.  Wafting gases from the north lend a faint, unpleasant odor to the surroundings, but stunted pines and several scraggly junipers heavy-laden with berries seem to thrive in the temperate span.  Smoke trails across the sky, belching from a lava-drenched mountain far in the distance.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Inland Road]
35024.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Though no less fierce, the wind loses its wintry chill as the road reaches a narrow fissure spanned by a black stone bridge.  Dozens of feet down, lava surges sluggishly, giving off an overwhelming odor of molten metal.  Waves of heat wash up from the breach, distorting the air around the bridge in a way that makes the tenebrous expanse seem to dance and shift.
title: [Scrimshaw Cliffs, Bridge]
35025.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Spanning an infernal fissure flooded with molten rock, a black stone bridge strains toward the more solid ground of the coastal cliffs to the south.  Noxious gases roil up from the chasm's depths and hang in low, unsavory banks of fog over the scorched landscape.  Clouds of toxic smoke fill the air, their underbellies illuminated by the rivers of lava threading through the flats like veins of liquid fire.
title: [Glaoveln, Seething Flats]
35026.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An ancient shale boulder, painstakingly shaped by the river that once wound through the region, provides a vantage of the blasted plain.  Far to the north, a foreboding city with crude stone walls sprawls atop a grim plateau.  East of the vestige of habitation, a black mountain scrapes at the sky, streaks of lava illuminating its slopes.  Its peak is a shattered ruin that belches clouds of smoke and ash onto the tortured lands below.
title: [Seething Flats, Shale Rise]
35027.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Air warps and shimmers over the wide body of a lava flow.  The deadly flood of molten rock surges sluggishly down the bed of a river that once occupied the plains.  All that remains of the lost body of water is its imprint on the earth.  Vegetation is sparse and brown, the life choked from it by the oppressive heat and the scalding gases that sweep across the tormented plain.
title: [Seething Flats, Lava River]
35028.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Treacherous expanses of partially cooled lava lurk along the path, no longer aglow with heat but not yet solid enough to support meaningful weight.  They are indistinguishable from the ridges and swirls of more solid basalt deposited by the continuing pyroclasm that has consumed the surrounding plain.  Pools of lava bubble and churn, fed by constant upheavals beneath the wounded earth.
title: [Seething Flats, Lava Pools]
35029.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A narrow thread of solid ground winds close to the shores of a lake of lava.  Superheated smoke rises in choking billows from the slowly churning expanse, stinking of sulphur and molten metal.  Tiny islands of igneous rock dot the surface, but cracks of lava seethe between them, threatening their brief span of stability.
title: [Seething Flats, Lava Lake]
35030.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lava seethes from cracks in the tortured earth near the narrow ribbon of stable ground.  Gouts of black smoke and superheated steam accompany the glowing, molten rock, commingling to fill the air with a sharp, metallic tang.  Flakes of ash swirl like snowflakes in the hot breeze, pirouetting and dancing as if oblivious to the land's torment.
title: [Seething Flats, Lava Pools]
35031.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A vast expanse of basalt breaches out of the earth, broken free and knocked askew by the churning of the magma below.  Pools of molten lava lap at the edges of the great rock, threatening to consume it.  Clouds swirl overhead, agitated by the fury of the ongoing pyroclasm.
title: [Seething Flats, Broken Earth]
35032.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several spars of basalt lie in a broken tumble, the standing stones toppled by the shaking of the shiftless earth.  Carved with symbols and shapes, they are worn almost smooth by the years and the ungentle caress of the winds.  Several are half-buried in drifts of falling ash, and risk being lost to view entirely.
title: [Seething Flats, Fallen Totems]
35033.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lying on its side in a dried-up riverbed, a fishing barge has surrendered to the surrounding cataclysm.  With its cabin crushed by a huge black pyroclast, the boat would be useless even if it were near to water, but none is in sight, the river's flow having been disrupted by the convulsions of the earth.  Char mars the intact wood of the hull in patterns reminiscent of grasping talons.
title: [Seething Flats, Barge]
35034.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shimmers of heat warp the air over a smoking crater brimming with roiling lava.  Gases and smoke pour off of the surface in choking billows heavy-laden with gritty ash.  Cajoled by the hot winds screaming over the flats, the smoke twists and twitches into strange, ominous shapes as it drifts skyward.
title: [Seething Flats, Crater]
35035.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A dull roar in the air clashes with the screeching of the wind, as if the earth is moaning in desperation.  The sound emanates from dozens of gashes in the earth, from which erupt billows of hot, sulphurous steam.  Beyond the odor of rotting eggs, the smell of molten rock is heavy on the air and inescapable.
title: [Seething Flats, Fumaroles]
35036.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lent speed by their travel down the slopes of an ash-clad mountain to the north, lava flows surge in glowing channels, eating runnels out of the shattered earth.  The narrowest of trails threads between the lethal rivulets, winding northeast toward a high plateau overlooking the devastation.  The stones underfoot rumble ceaselessly, as if the earth below had a thudding, racing heartbeat.
title: [Seething Flats, Lava Flows]
35037.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The trailway climbs toward higher ground, weaving through falling ash and around rivers of blazing lava.  To the west stands a mountain with a broken peak, one of several fountaining its fiery blood onto the lowlands.  Northward rises a vast plateau cloven in twain by a river of molten rock.  Winds carry the distant sounds of civilization, from the creak of carts to the cries of children, but they come in tantalizing snatches lost to the louder complaints of the earth.
title: [Seething Flats, Trail]
35038.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The roadway widens and refines its borders as it rises out of the suffering valley below.  Paved with dark stones, the road winds up toward the plateau above.  A vantage along the roadside provides a glimpse of the destruction below, which is as beautiful as it is terrible.  Streams of lava lay draped across the blackened land like glowing lariats, and fields of shattered obsidian glint harshly in the wan moonlight.
title: [Glaoveln Road, Rise]
35039.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dark paving stones frame a broad roadway that twists and turns with the jagged switchbacks mounting a spacious plateau.  High walls of rough-hewn basalt loom above, marking the borders of a foreboding city that occupies the flatland.  Though muted by the night, the buzz of the city seeps over the walls: the sound of distant weeping, the creak of a wagon wheel, and the scuffle of a bar fight echo off of the rock to either side of the road.
title: [Glaoveln Road, Switchbacks]
35040.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dagger-sharp switchbacks climb toward the city atop the unforgiving plateau, the basalt walls casting long shadows over the road.  Veins of obsidian thread through the dark, porous rock, the volcanic glass glinting coldly in the starlight.  Near the lip of the plateau, the roadway is paved with wide dark stones and winds toward the gates of the city.
title: [Glaoveln Road, Switchbacks]
35041.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flakes of ash cling to the ground and waver in the sere winds roiling up from the volcanic flats below the plateau.  They dust wagons and stalls resting in the shadow of the city's basalt walls, which stretch imposingly toward the smoky skies.  Age-darkened whalebone inlay set into the walls depicts nautical scenes and no small amount of bloodshed.
title: [Glaoveln Road, Approach]
35042.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Framed and inlaid with scrimshawed whalebone, a reinforced gate of black spruce guards the entrance into the city.  High watchtowers loom over the entry, their crenellated crowns occupied by krolvin sentries armed with heavy arbalests.  Traffic flows through the gates in a clattering press of wagons and aurochs-drawn carts, perfuming the air with a bewildering melange of exotic spices, musk, and road dust.
title: [Glaoveln Road, Conquerors' Gate]
35043.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Beneath an imposing basalt arch etched with a snarling krolvin face, a reinforced black spruce gate opens onto a crowded plaza.  Animals screech from cages by a shouting street vendor, while nearby, a hawker gregariously peddles cold fish and hot broth to hungry travelers.  Krolvin sentries armed with arbalests watch over the throng from guard towers positioned to either side of the gateway.
title: [Glaeve, Conquerors' Gate]
35044.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A jagged precipice of blackened rock curves out over the seething flats below like a crooked talon.  The vantage it provides looks out over the blasted terrain, through gas clouds and smoke, toward a twisted mountain in the distance.  Veins of lava stream down its broken summit, which belches black smoke in a constant, choking stream.
title: [Glaoveln Road, Precipice]
35045.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bordered by blocky buildings of rough-hewn basalt, a teeming plaza is fed by several busy roads.  Seafarers mingle with brokers and traders amid the surging throng.  Fish in size from minnow to marlin are displayed on beds of gleaming crushed ice, while nearby, reavers furtively trade their spoils for coin.  Though the nearest building, a two-story auction house with a black, columned facade, has a stolid and foreboding look, the nearby stalls and tents come in a brawl of bright colors.
title: [Glaeve, Fortune Plaza]
35046.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A lush midnight blue runner unfurls from the arched entry of the auction house, escorted by a phalanx of carved basalt columns.  Banners of the same moody color, fringed with golden tassels, hang from the cloister vault ceiling, their swaying reflected in the uneven black stone tiles of the floor, which are polished and worn smooth.  Heavy glass panes laced through with adamantine filaments protect the acquisitioners working in the hall, and krolvin hireswords stand ready along the walls.
title: [The Trove, Procurement]
35047.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An off-key song with off-color lyrics brays from the torchlit windows of a long, one-storied inn sheltering beneath a crooked larch.  Needles, green and brown, blanket the flagstone road leading up to its entrance, where a one-eyed bouncer with a cudgel sorts customers from potential nuisances.  The roof of scale-shaped pine shingles is sealed with acrid tar.
title: [Glaeve, Leviathan Road]
35048.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Exposed rafters form an arch over the entryway, the dark pine ceiling filling the air with its rich and clean resinous scent.  Carved totems decorate the support posts that are evenly spaced throughout the corridor and fur stretchers displaying a variety of pelts decorate the spaces between.  Wrought iron brackets support large metal baskets filled with bowls of burning oil that provide both illumination and warmth.
title: [The Raider's Take, Entry]
35049.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: North of the road, the ugly, crooked bars of a spade-tipped barbed steel gate cast nebulous shadows in the pale moonlight.  Judging from the cracks in the tenebrous basalt walls and the pitting and rust scarring the bars, the metalwork is a relic of a time long past.  Large carts with wide beds are stationed outside, drawn by huge aurochs.  The placid beasts seem disquieted, as if by the ghost of an old scent on the frigid air.
title: [Glaeve, Fortune Street]
35050.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crude and uneven, the gate leading into the marketplace is an old monument.  Broken chains hang from the parapets to either side, rusting and corroding in the harsh elements.  Beyond the gates the marketplace is host to a jumble of tents, carts, wagons, and stalls in a motley of makes and origins.  A bas-relief on one nearby wall of the compound is obscured by a triumphant mural in strident blues and vivid golds.
title: [Glaeve, Mizklog gno Gzadmor]
35051.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dark basalt columns stretch to the high ceiling of the auction house's grand hall, twined with scenes of nautical warfare in gold leaf.  They march toward a pair of arched steel double doors occupying much of the far wall.  Spaced between the pilasters are several cases framed by adamantine-laced glass, each containing relics arranged atop a spill of cerulean velvet.  Hireswords, as heavily armed as they are implacable stand watch atop lofty balconies above.
title: [The Trove, Grand Hall]
35052.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The skeleton of a vast sea animal hangs from the ceiling by heavy chains of dark steel, and the lights of the chandeliers above filter through its ossified remains.  Dozens of leather-padded seats stand in neat rows before a raised lectern carved from ebony and inlaid with veins of ice blue mithril.  Behind stands a long, flat trestle table of the same dark wood, intricate carvings on its polished surface gleaming in the light of candles flickering through a stained glass window framing the rostrum.
title: [The Trove, Auction Hall]
35053.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Short steps separate the intimate chamber from the looming majesty of the adjoining hall.  A dazzling collection of moldering relics and strangely glowing magical items occupies a series of reinforced ebony cases along the far wall, neatly catalogued and evenly spaced.  Specimens marked for immediate sale occupy velvet-clad tables spaced in a semicircle.   Between the cases, an archway houses a winding basalt staircase that winds up to a small outdoor patio atop the building.
title: [The Trove, Buyouts]
35054.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Frigid wind scours the rooftop patio, shivering the branches of a pair of dwarf pines clad in spiraling strands of fine silver chain.  The low wall surrounding the space offers a panoramic view of Fortune Plaza's sprawl below, with its brightly colored tents, stalls, and wagons.  Near the northeastern corner of the patio, a winding basalt staircase descends into the auction house.
title: [The Trove, Patio]
35055.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Set back from the road at the end of a lane shaded by red larches is an ostentatious guild hall flying black and gold banners.  Carriages and wagons are chained to stakes in the spacious yard, most overseen by armored guards and mercenaries.  A plate of solid brass is riveted to the lintel over the arched entrance and depicts a set of scales heavy-laden with coin.
title: [Glaeve, Fortune Street]
35056.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Scents of exotic spice and strange incense are heavy on the air of the capacious foyer, the walls of which are lined with leather-upholstered benches graced by carved bone buttons.  The seats look upon a monumental statue of lightly verdigrised bronze depicting a hand holding scales aloft, one side weighed down by a pile of coin.  Pennants from several dozen different ships, comprising a variety of shapes and clashing colors, hang from the ceiling, wafting toward a mosaic arch in the northern wall.
title: [Traders' Hall, Foyer]
35057.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Secured by a pair of gilded doors, a long gallery runs the length of the structure.  Its high granite walls and black walnut floors magnify the slightest sound, from the whispers of traders engaged in quiet dealings to the hasty patter of runners' footsteps as they carry messages to and from the guild hall.  Though one wall is given over to large picture windows overlooking the bustle of Fortune Street, the other holds foreign artworks in dozens of disparate styles.
title: [Traders' Hall, Gallery]
35058.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: High blocks of caliginous basalt stand along one side of the path through the market, rivets in the blocks securing the broken remains of chains.  They are almost obscured by a collection of tents from abroad flying several foreign standards and personal banners.  One hexagonal pavilion to the fore of the group is paneled in bright red and sunny yellow silks.
title: [Glaeve, Mizklog gno Gzadmor]
35059.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: At the center of the marketplace, the shattered remains of a statue stand atop a grey granite plinth.  Only the boots remain, the legs attached to them reduced to jagged stumps.  A parliament of stalls and tents have been erected at the base of the broken monument, opposite a wagon of golden oak with a series of steps leading up to its covered bed.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, west, northwest
title: [Glaeve, Mizklog gno Gzadmor]
35060.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dilipidated pillars, denuded of the artworks they once held, shelter along the far wall of the marketplace.  Vibrant banners hang from stone arches and flap in the cold wind, casting patterns of dancing shadow over the colorful stalls that occupy the niche.  The bazaar thrives and seethes with its newfound purpose, though dark grace notes of its history manifest in the broken chains riveted to the walls and the blocks spaced along the walkway.
title: [Glaeve, Mizklog gno Gzadmor]
35061.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bone charms swing from the entrance to a midnight blue canvas tent, though their clacking is nearly lost in the symphony of haggling and peddling filling the air.  It and several carriages almost obscure the view of some steel pens along the bazaar's wall that have been left to rust and ruin.  Customers laden with fresh purchases swirl like detritus down the narrow pathway before the tent, but most give it wide berth.
title: [Glaeve, Mizklog gno Gzadmor]
35062.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The street curves sharply into a hook-like bend following the curve of the wall, which is in turn guided by the bounds of the plateau the city dominates.  Cut from the same bleak stone as the walls guarding the city, a courier's shop lurks at the end of the flourishing row of businesses.  Hanging over its door is a dyed teal jute banner depicting a set of winged boots.  Customers laden with parcels and post bustle in and out of the single-door entrance.
title: [Glaeve, Fortune and Scythe]
35063.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Windows glazed with a tracery of rime look out upon the busy street, but the duty of lighting the drafty timber post office is given over to torches hanging from the walls in bronze brackets.  They fill the air with the tang of pine pitch and more than a little acrid smoke that has blackened the timbers over a burled modwir desk that sits just slightly askew due to one bent leg.  Occasional high-pitched cries pierce the air, emanating down from the mews up above.
title: [Driftwood Dispatch, Post]
35064.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Smoke pours, black and thick, from the chimneys of armorers' and weaponsmiths' shops flanking the street.  They fill the cold, salty air with the choking grit of hot forge ash and the tang of heated metal.  Wagons laden with ore and ingots crowd the available space near to the businesses, though one bustling smithy has a clear lane leading up to its entrance.
title: [Glaeve, Scythe Bend]
35065.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crude wooden busts of various height are arranged along the walls.  Most of the busts are layered with unfinished leathers, while others support partially constructed suits of heavier, steel chain and plate armors.  Krolvin armorers wearing dye-stained clothes work diligently as they move between this workspace and a partition of tanned hides toward the back of the smithy.
title: [Bittersteel, Smithy]
35066.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A scrimshander's shop sits along the gloomy row.  Carved whalebone chimes hung from the shop's eaves clatter almost musically in the driving wind, filling the quiet span of roadway with their hollow percussion.  Before the entrance stands a statue of a merrow carved entirely from a whale's mandible.  The creature's scaled body is intricately tattooed with cobalt blue ink.
title: [Glaeve, Stormcaller Row]
35067.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas
