description: Ink pots in blue and black hues line the shelves behind a long driftwood counter, adding contrast to the yellowed bone items alongside them.  A stooped krolvin carver shuffles about behind the counter, sharpening her tools and tending to her wares.
title: [Ink and Bone, Showroom]
35068.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: One of the squat black stone buildings along the cobblestone street is an alchemist's shop, as evidenced by the brightly colored potion bottles glinting from its windows.  An old stone idol stands in the red grass yard before the store.  Most of its features are worn away, but a hunched posture and a mouth of jagged fangs suggest that it once depicted a krolvin form.  The air around the idol buzzes as if alive with energy.
title: [Glaeve, Stormcaller Row]
35069.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Comprised of squat, dark stones, the walls of the shop are carved with numerous symbols around idol-filled niches.  Several dusty, curtained windows let in dim light, each lined with brightly colored potion bottles, and dozens of vials, crystals, and other alchemical accoutrements are haphazardly arranged along wooden counters and shelves.
title: [The Crucible, Counter]
35070.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The air of the street faintly crackles with energy washing off of carved idols spaced between its low edifices of black stone.  Old beyond reckoning, the carvings are vaguely humanoid and worked of a waxy black rock that does not appear native to the island.  Cobblestones glisten under dim lantern light, damp from mist.  Merchants along the street proudly display their wares from candlelit windows: rare treasures wrested from the sea, shimmering jewels, and weathered maps promising a way to untamed lands.
title: [Glaeve, Stormcaller Row]
35071.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several small sharks and squid are draped across raised beds of ice outside a fishmonger's shop near the end of the row.  Given the nauseating melange of tanning solutions and slaughter drifting from the eastern verges of the thoroughfare, the briny crispness of fresh fish is like a nosegay for the beleaguered nose.  A preserved kraken tentacle is mounted above the shop's double doors.
title: [Glaeve, Bloodrow]
35072.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dried cod line nearly every inch of the wall behind the driftwood counter, which boasts numerous tubs filled with chipped ice topped with various fillets of fresh fish.  A large arctic crab is displayed on the opposite wall.
title: [The Kraken's Catch, Market]
35073.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Heat, sere and overpowering, washes up in shimmering waves from a chasm splitting the plateau in twain to the west.  Steep walls of slick obsidian plummet toward a narrow ribbon of lava dizzyingly far below.  Only a railing of wood stakes and braided sinew stands between a hapless traveler and a final fall.  A bridge of volcanic stone, its parapets elaborately carved with a tangle of sea serpents, spans the gap.  The sturdy bridge seems a thin and treacherous thing given the drop to either side.
title: [Glaeve, Leviathan Road]
35074.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lava surges sluggishly in the ravine below the crumbling precipice, as if the gash were a livid wound in the face of the world.  Though the molten rock lies far below the jag of stable ground, the heat churning up from the burning flow is overpowering in its intensity.  A carved black stone bridge arcs from the opposite side of the chasm, anchored to stone by scaffolding and heavy rivets.
title: [Glaeve, The Ravening Chasm]
35075.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Leering mercenaries with crossbows patrol the yard and entrance of a countinghouse.  The building is virtually a fortress in its own right, with spiraled bars of wrought iron reinforcing every window and archers stationed on the crenellated rooftop.  Carriages with smoked glass windows are hitched to a post out front, suggesting prosperous clientele.  Hanging from a dark stone column in front of the business is a heavy brass sign etched with teetering stacks of coin.
title: [Glaeve, Leviathan Road]
35076.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sunlight spills through the high windows recessed into the blackwashed walls, creating bands of shadows and light upon the heavy cobblestone blocks of the floor.  Brass fixtures adorn the edges of each accounting booth, where lanterns provide additional illumination, the polished metal gleaming and lending an air of opulence to the otherwise austere space.  Twin arches lead deeper into the structure, while a steel reinforced ladder leads to a guardsmen's ledge where archers watch the proceedings with keen eyes.
title: [The Black Vault, Atrium]
35077.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Prosperous businesses crowd the northern side of the street, patronized by a steady stream of seafarers and traders.  Sheltered by a bend in the city's outer wall is a vast monument of volcanic glass that has been worked with surpassing skill.  It takes the form of a three-headed serpent breaching through storm-tossed waves.  Gold, silver, and gems have been heaped in a basin at the base of the statue, where tallow candles flicker and smoke in the icy wind.
title: [Glaeve, Leviathan Road]
35078.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Driftwood shelves jut from the raw timber walls, stained by saltwater but sturdy enough to support the weight of the packing materials lining them.  Only a single torch lights the niche, leaving its smoky eaves partly lost in shadow.  A small display of envelopes and stampbooks sits atop the counter, accompanied by several cylinders of wax in different colors.
title: [Driftwood Dispatch, Parcels]
35079.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A pall of falling ash blankets the street.  It is difficult to tell what is the work of the volcano looming across the flats outside of the city's plateau and what has been birthed from the street's many forges.  An arms dealer's shop seeks to stand out from the rest of its ash-dusted competitors by flying a ship's purloined colors, but the flag, once vibrant green and crisp white, is stained with soot.
title: [Glaeve, Scythe Bend]
35080.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Garbed in a soot-stained blacksmith's apron, Bladeturner Agrakh stands proudly between matching racks on either side of the showroom.  Many of the armaments on display have carved bone hilts, while others are graced with a haft of dark wood.  The hammering of metal against metal resounds from a workspace in the back of the shop, and a ruddy glow from the forge intermittently illuminates the interior between the moving shadows of those busy at work.
title: [Agrakh's Anvil, Showroom]
35081.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Opposite some drab greyed wooden stables, an embrasure in the city's wall is occupied by a large red oak ballista.  The squared dip in the wall provides a panoramic view of the island's northeastern reaches, though the furthest extremes of the vista are obscured by mists and ashfall.  Vast evergreen forests spread out along the valleys to the northeast, stretching almost to the black sand shores.
title: [Glaeve, Scythe Bend]
35082.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A thick layer of sawdust, hay, and dirt covers the ground, providing insulation from the cold.  Stalls have been set back from the entryway to the east and west, away from the arctic winds.
title: [Krol, Walk, or Ride, Entrance]
35083.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stink of offal and blood rises, heavy and thick into the cold air, and is little dispelled by the whipping breeze.  Its source is a butcher's shop with an attached slaughterhouse, though the latter is as far back from the street as the mighty basalt walls of the city will allow.  Several aurochs are tied to carts in the yard, but the smell has awakened an uneasy agitation in their normally placid bearing.
title: [Glaeve, Bloodrow and Scythe]
35084.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Various cuts of venison and seal hang from hooks above and behind a wooden counter.  Sawdust spread across the floor absorbs the grease, fat, and blood from the butchery, providing a little traction and insulation from the cold.
title: [The Corsair's Cut, Counter]
35085.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stinging, sharp stink that is the unfailing accompaniment of the furrier's trade hangs like a pall over the road, resisting the efforts of the whipping wind to dispel the oppressive stench.  Several nearby shops have hides and furs stretched out on wooden racks to cure.  One tannery, larger and more prosperous than the rest, has a censer of strong incense suspended from a chain above its entrance.
title: [Glaeve, Bloodrow]
35086.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Knotted pine boards line the walls of the spacious shop, the golden wood partially covered by a variety of exotic pelts and skins.  Piles of tanned hides are stacked around a worn counter inlaid with bits of shark teeth.  Several copper and bronze lanterns hang from the exposed rafters above, casting a pale glow over the room.
title: [Tooth and Claw]
35087.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wooden planks separate the pens from the hallway, providing owners and passersby an opportunity to examine the animals contained within.  The air here is stagnant; warm, close, and pungent.
title: [Krol, Walk, or Ride; West]
35088.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wooden planks separate the pens from the hallway, providing owners and passersby an opportunity to examine the animals contained within.  The air here is stagnant; warm, close, and pungent.
title: [Krol, Walk, or Ride; East]
35089.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Along one wall of the narrow room is a cast iron stove next to a coiled basket while the other is filled with shelves and cabinets.  At the far end of the room a series of squat wooden stools are arranged in a semicircle in front of a stacked stone fireplace.
title: [The Kraken's Catch, Galley]
35090.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stygian crenellations of the Ashka Krol strain up over the rooftops of buildings to the northwest, as if the fortress's uppermost reaches were clawing at the bitter sky.  Carts laden with nets full of glistening fish creak and clatter over the cobblestones, heading north to restaurants and well-to-do fishmongers' shops.  The day's catch seasons the air with a smell of saltwater and the telltale odor of fish guts.
title: [Glaeve, Razorfin Road]
35091.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lit from within by flickering torches, a severe stone shrine stands at the crescent's northern verges, apart from the weapons dealers and armorers that are the area's more common denizens.  An old scimitar is mounted above the entrance, the blade so black that it does not reflect the ambient light.
title: [Glaeve, Bloodfang Crescent]
35092.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Standing tall and broad enough that its shoulders scrape the walls of the shrine, an unlovely bronze statue of a scarred krolvin warrior stands atop a plinth of blood red stone.  He leers at a twisted steel altar forged together from swords and daggers, their still-sharp tips jutting cruelly from the fused mass.  Incense smoke hangs on the close air in stinging drifts, smelling of laurel and bloodwood.
title: [Shrine of Battle, Altar]
35093.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Nearly as tall as a man, old stone carvings meant to resemble shark teeth frame the road to either side.  A tailor's shop stands away from the statuary, separated from them by a lawn of reddish green grass.  Fine textiles in a wide assortment of colors and styles are displayed within, while a spruce wood sign over the entrance is carved with a needle and thread.
title: [Glaeve, Sharktooth Row]
35094.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wall panels of bronze and gold are pierced with designs representing distant landscapes, from mountains clad in wild woods to sprawling deserts.  They reflect the light of a few beeswax candles sweetening the air of the tidy shop, the space of which is efficiently devoted to dress-clad mannequins and small bolts of fine textiles.  Most are more common imports like fraelhan and velvet, though a few hold spidersilk and splendid fabrics from half a world away.
title: [Rorg's, Salon]
35095.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Separated from the outer room of the shop by a patterned copper silk curtain, the parlor is smaller and more intimate, though richly appointed with a soft suede couch and a small fireplace.  An ash worktable with mother-of-pearl inlay houses a number of tools of the tailor's trade, including tapes, shears, and pins.  The sanctuary is watched over by a smiling mask in gold and vivid blue that is graced with musical notes at the edges.
title: [Rorg's, Parlor]
35096.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Past a series of stone statues carved into the forms of shark teeth, a shop is marked by a driftwood sign carved with a pair of shoes.  The evident cobbler does brisk trade, judging from the traffic through and out of its pine double doors.  Through the wide bay windows, the shop appears to cater to sailors, as its wares include a wide variety of mariner's boots.  There are also other styles in abundance.
title: [Glaeve, Sharktooth Row]
35097.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Across from a series of wide bay windows, a long driftwood counter separates the cobbling workroom from patrons milling around the shop entrance overstocked with vendable supplies.  Bits of cork, strands of rope, and pieces of canvas protrude from a series of reed baskets hanging from a scarred beam.  An endless stream of plain paper-wrapped packages slide down a metal chute, some making it onto the smooth countertop, while most end up in a heap on the floor.
title: [Cobbler's Corner, Entry]
35098.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Standing sneering atop a parapet, the weathered bronze statue of a powerfully built krolvin holds a smaller squirming figure aloft.  Victory is written across his cruel features.  Untended, the figure has developed a patina of verdigris, but it is also spattered in the droppings of seabirds, which have left a goopy white shawl about his shoulders.  The nearby homes are small and dark, and there is little foot traffic along the thoroughfare.
title: [Glaeve, Reaver's Run]
35099.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crossed cutlasses hang over the grandiose double doors of a two-story chapterhouse guarded by a granite wall.  Ornate carvings adorn the dark stone, depicting scenes of nautical combat and tall ships with heavy cannons and fierce crews.  The wrought iron rails of the upper story's balconies are festooned with garish pennants, each stitched with an emblem.  The sigils range from mundane skulls and crossbones to flamboyant birds and vicious predators of the sea.
title: [Glaeve, Reaver's Run]
35100.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Pilasters that look to have been severed from several different buildings ring the circular chamber fronting the chapterhouse, their disparate styles suggesting a gamut of cultural origins.  Bronze statues stand in niches between them, glowering krolvin faces looking down upon a basalt floor with a blood red compass rose inlaid at the center.  Guild members in riotous attire ebb and flow through an arched opening of scrimshawed whalebone in the northern wall.
title: [Reavers' Rest, Rotunda]
35101.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Triumphant krolvin statues of volcanic stone stand on hexagonal pedestals in front of a fortified countinghouse at a bend in the street.  Salt and wind have colluded to erode the statues' features.  The business stands out from its immediate neighbors due to its impressive size, but all of the shops along the road are well-to-do, their coffers swollen from trade in contraband and plunder.
title: [Glaeve, Reaver's Run]
35102.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The roar of frantic betting echoes loudly from the arched stone entrance of a gambling hall, accompanied by the clink of plentiful coin.  The hall's cracked facade occupies a wide stretch of the run, and an array of carriages and carts are hitched in its yard.  Here and there loiter krolvin sailors with brimming coinpurses, ready to tempt fate.  The richness of coldleaf tobacco wafts from one open window.
title: [Glaeve, Darkwater Run]
35103.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The looming shadow of the city's western wall stretches over the run, casting it in shadow.  Small shops of rough pine and stone cling to either side of the roadside, but none seem especially well-to-do, their niche wares attracting only a scattering of patrons.  Passersby move along the road with hasty steps and furtive glances, as if eager to be out of the cold darkness.
title: [Glaeve, Darkwater Run]
35104.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cradled by a high wall crowned with sharp spikes, a shadowed manse shelters far from the thoroughfare of the run.  Gloom clings to the sanctum, and its cavernous black windows stare out at the street like empty eye sockets.  Hanging from the lintel over the gate is a carved bloodwood sign painted with a single crimson droplet.  The foreign wood contrasts stridently with the spruce and pine signs gracing nearby buildings.  The larches in the yard have crimson needles, black trunks, and a sickly look.
title: [Glaeve, Darkwater Run]
35105.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fire burns brightly in the small hearth opposite the entrance of the manse, its too-red hue bathing the dark stone of the foyer in dancing light.  Walls of basalt are riddled with impurities that manifest as deep maroon swirls on their surface, a languid pattern that is repeated in the polished black marble of the floor.  Masks hang from the walls, but they are of simple make, brightly painted wood and leather not matching the relative finery of the chamber that they decorate.
title: [The Crimson House, Entry]
35106.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sounds of gushing water roar over the southern wall of the city.  Steps climb to an overlook that provides a glimpse over the fortifications, where a rushing current of frothing water plummets over the plateau's edge toward a lake far below.  A bookseller has taken advantage of the picturesque spot and has set up her cart at the bend in the road.  The titles on display come in a variety of languages, but those in the common tongue are lurid and licentious almost to the point of parody.
title: [Glaeve, Bitterbrine Walk]
35107.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cart strides the boundary between ramshackle and well-used, its paint flaking in the salt air and the exposed wood silvered by exposure to long years in the sun.  Shelves anchored to its outer wall are packed with books, from moldering old tomes to fresh volumes bound in newly polished leather.  Painted narwhals cavort and joust with spiraled horns just above the wheel wells.
title: [Brazka's Books, Cart]
35108.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crashing waves are limned on the interior of the city wall, the graffiti adding a splash of color to the hewn stone's otherwise unleavened darkness.  A melange of sweetly floral and bitterly astringent aromas wafts from the chimney of an apothecary's shop along the opposite side of the street.  Nosegays are hung over the business's porch, the delicate huskiness of white heather colluding with the soporific sweetness of resting poppy to conceal less savory aromas.
title: [Glaeve, Bitterbrine Walk]
35109.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sinew-bound drapes of mottled furs and pelts frame the rough brick walls of the apothecary shop, the thick layers providing additional warmth alongside the blackened iron hearth nestled in the back corner.  Sturdy ironwood shelves cover the available space against the walls, filled with stone jars labeled in aged parchment, the containers nestled in beds of straw.  A mortar-flanked counter sits at the center of the room, its gouged surface covered in a variety of stains concealed by hide-covered tomes.
title: [Bitter Brews, Shop]
35110.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Seaglass in a hodgepodge of bright colors has been used as tesserae in the face of a stone shrine set back from the road.  The smell of burning seaweed emanates from within, carried on clouds of light grey smoke that puff from the building's chimney.  Sailors frequent the monument, draping offerings over the tines of a carved driftwood trident hanging over the entrance or leaving them in a stone bowl nearby.
title: [Glaeve, Tidehunter Row]
35111.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A carpet of woven sea grasses, dried and dyed a rich cobalt blue, stretches from the entrance of the shrine to a dais at the far end.  Atop the rise stands a single chair of seaglass, and just below it awaits an altar of the same translucent material.  A trident of pure gold hangs from the ceiling by a pair of chains, its tines studded with bright-colored jewels.
title: [Shrine of Tides, Altar]
35112.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A rough-and-tumble pub stands at a bend in the road.  Smaller and dingier than the more successful establishments to either side, the bar's clientele are mostly bedecked in the crimson and cerulean of the quartermaster's office or the black and azure of the Czag Dubra's fighting company.  Grizzled and scarred, they crowd the pub's booths, filling the air with a riot of jeers and laughter.
title: [Glaeve, Bloodfang Crescent]
35113.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dangling from the exposed rafter ceiling, a candelabra of heavy paddle-shaped antlers supports dozens of half-melted candles that provide a soft illumination to the dingy tavern.  Rough benches and stools crowd the space, leaving barely enough room to sidle up to the dark pine and oak bar.  Dingy windows gaze out upon the street, their dirty panes limned in frost, causing it to be impossible to see through them.
title: [The Maid of Dolphins, Bar]
35114.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The clash of steel rings out sharply from the enclosed yard of a barracks near the crescent.  Flying black and azure banners marked with a notched cutlass, the outpost occupies a capacious edifice that has the look of a small fortress.  A few seabirds have nested in the eaves, staining the dark stone white with their leavings.
title: [Glaeve, Bloodfang Crescent]
35115.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shale chips landscape the ground of the sparring yard, the crunching gravel offering necessary purchase in the ice-slicked outdoors.  Rows of dummies made from sackcloth and wooden posts stand in formation near the arched double doors leading into the dormitory, but they are a motley crew, scored and pummeled by hits from training swords and even peppered with arrows.  Flapping blue banners fly from the dormitory, which encompasses the yard on three sides.
title: [Bloodfang Barracks, Yard]
35116.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Hammocks are strung between wooden posts down the length of the long room, a tenebrous procession not leavened by the windowless charcoal-colored walls.  Beneath each hammock sits a footlocker secured by a heavy steel lock.  A few personal effects lend needed spirit to the dormitory, from a handful of bone dice sitting atop one of the lockers to a small leather bracelet threaded through the knots of one hammock.
title: [Bloodfang Barracks, Bunks]
35117.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flying cerulean standards whip in the breeze over the quartermaster's office, sporting a sigil of a horned crab and dagger in crimson.  The building is almost a palace in its own right, and its windows offer glimpses of fine furnishings and lush curtains.  In somber contrast stands the ramshackle jail attached to the office, a single-story hall with barred windows with no glass to shield occupants from the unrelenting cold.  Hulking enforcers stand guard outside with cudgels in easy reach.
title: [Glaeve, Bloodfang Crescent]
35118.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cerulean silk banners hang to either side of the high arched entrance of the office, each sporting a horned crab clasping a red dagger.  Cold sunlight streams through the heavy panes of the curtained windows, pooling over the fine textiles upholstering a sumptuous fraelhan couch.  A regal reception desk looks down on the foyer, its dark wood boasting insets of ebony and rosewood.
title: [Quartermaster's, Entry]
35119.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The windows of a nearby dwelling are open to reveal an interior bedecked in nautical relics and weathered seafaring maps.  A statue of a proud-looking human magister, divorced from its old base with obvious force, appears to be the centerpiece of the collection.  Krolvin workers in drab homespun make their way along the road.  Some attend wagons drawn by aurochs, but the poorer ones drag their own carts, filling the air with a pained squeaking of battered wheels.
title: [Glaeve, Tidehunter Row]
35120.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The interior of this dwelling is filled with treasures of the sea, some clearly weathered from exposure and brine.  Myriad maps of Elanthia and its oceans decorate the walls, and a rack high above holds a plethora of trinkets just out of reach of even the tallest giantman.  The cracked statue of a human magister is displayed in one corner, adjacent to a makeshift wooden counter used to conduct business with a fidgety krolvin elder who keeps a vigilant watch over her collected hoard of goods.
title: [Glorious Porpoise]
35121.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A high watchtower stands guard over the bend in the road, guarding an expanse of the city wall.  Enforcers in cerulean and crimson staff the outpost, though they seem to devote less time watching threats from outside the walls than on those within.  Their tabards are emblazoned with the horned crab and dagger of the quartermaster's office, and they are a burly, hard-looking lot.
title: [Glaeve, Bitterbrine Walk]
35122.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A craggy statue of a leaping marlin stands between two fishmongers' shops.  Some of their product, curing in the cold air, blankets the street with a briny, too-sweet odor held almost at bay by aromatic evergreen logs burning in a brazier before the southernmost business.  The other shop's windows offer a glimpse onto preserved pufferfish and shells suspended from a line of sinew, the decorations hanging above a display of fresh-caught fish on ice beds.
title: [Glaeve, Razorfin Road]
35123.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The backs of tall statues flanking the Path of Glory loom over the comparatively humble storefronts along Razorfin Road.  There is little glory to be found on the street; only fish, but they exist in plenitude, filling the bellies of carts chained up in front of a variety of businesses dependent upon the sea's bounty.  Gulls, lured away from the island's shores by the prospect of an easy meal, circle over the street, filling the air with their cries and drenching the rooftops with their droppings.
title: [Glaeve, Razorfin Road]
35124.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Nearly eight yards long from nose to tail, a colossal shark is held aloft by a series of spruce racks outside of a prosperous tavern along the chasm's edge.  The fearsome beast smells of the sea, and its bulk is unmarred save for a harpoon wound in its side.  Ragtag sailors and colorfully dressed captains alike mill in the throng outside the whalebone-inlaid doors.  Ship lanterns hang from heavy brass chains to either side of the entrance, though they are unlit and soot-stained in the cold light of day.
title: [Glaeve, Razorfin Road]
35125.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Chain-strung ship lanterns illuminate a thick layer of cigar smoke hovering above a long basalt-topped bar lined with several mismatched stools and a buxom mermaid figurehead propped at one end.  Stacked against the back wall behind the bar, tapped oak barrels branded with exotic ports of call drip ale onto crates filled with bottled spirits.  Several tables have been pushed out of the way to make room for a dart board fashioned from a ringed section of tree trunk stuck with a bone-handled dagger in the center.
title: [The Last Bite, Bar]
35126.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Separated from the hubbub of the bar by a dusty velvet curtain, a pair of sturdy wooden chairs face each other across a scarred pine table.  A flickering oil lamp casts eerie shadows on the dark-paneled walls, lacing the somber ambience of the nook with a hint of intrigue.  A musty smell lingers near a shelf filled with leather-bound logbooks, their spines cracked and yellowed.
title: [The Last Bite, Nook]
35127.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The northern wall of the city ends in a jagged breach, and the cracked remains of the heavy basalt blocks composing it litter the lip of the chasm that has broken the city in twain.  Through the vast gap, the harsh beauty of the island beckons, snow-capped forests and rolling hills drawing the eye to the cold black shores to the north.  Heedless of nature's fury and splendor, a cedar plank shop stands in the shadow of the wall, built on the foundations of an older stone dwelling that has been lost to time.
title: [Glaeve, Razorfin and Salt]
35128.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Oil lamps hanging from crossbeams overhead shed warm light down on this spacious shop.  Behind a long black spruce counter that divides the room's workspace and display area is a smooth, ample workbench with a padded stool directly behind it, facing the entry.  Bins full of various materials stand at the ready behind the stool.  On the floor by the far wall, a small cast iron brazier with a hood that directs smoke out through the roof radiates enough heat to fill the entire room.  Various goods hang from hooks in the shop area.
title: [Glaoveln Goods]
35129.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Pocked and pitted from the brine in the air, the Salt Gate is a lofty confection of stout metal set into the face of the city's northern wall.  Suckered tentacles of verdigris copper twine around the steel bars, which are fashioned with ornamental barnacles spiraling down their length.  Beyond, snatches of verdant green woodland and white-capped hills beckon.  A vast procession of black steps, worn smooth by time and the passage of many travelers, descends from the plateau toward the untamed wild.
title: [Glaeve, Salt Gate]
35130.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Broad blocks of salt slumber unattended in the yard of one nearby shop.  Coarse white crystals gleam in the moonlight from pitch-sealed pine barrels along the business's outer wall.  In the silence, traders in rugged attire haggle quietly over barrels, sacks, and bundles of the spice.  Above, the shop's weathervane, carved to resemble a ship's mast, creaks in the driving wind.
title: [Glaeve, Salt Street]
35131.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Long and dark, a stone plunder hall stands at the base of of the steps climbing toward the Ashka Krol.  The fortified palace looms, dark and predatory, over the street, flying crimson banners in the high winds.  Lit by torches from within, the hall's wide windows betray visions of plunder.  Piles of silver and gold coins glint from beds of black velvet, artworks from distant lands stand amidst suits of strange armor, and gems in a kaleidoscope of colors wink like a rainbow lent solid form.
title: [Glaeve, The Path of Glory]
35132.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Carved wooden figureheads are mounted to the walls of the hall near the base of the vaulted ceiling.  No two are precisely alike, having been carved from a variety of woods and in a range of styles, from exaggerated caricature to the astoundingly lifelike.  Pennants, tattered and sun-faded, hang among them, some scorched at the edges or sliced as if with blades.
title: [Plunder Hall, Entry]
35133.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Huge statues of proud krolvin in rugged attire flank the wide street as it rises toward the palace, abetted in its climb by a series of great hewn stone steps.  The statues cast diffuse shadows in the icy moonlight.  No two are the same.  One depicts a slender robed figure holding a gnarled staff aloft, while another, a muscular male in the coat and cap of a sea captain, raises an orb aloft in his sinewy hands.  Cobalt blue banners snap like thunder in the wind.
title: [Glaeve, The Path of Glory]
35134.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Ruling unchallenged over a great pinnacle of jutting stone at the plateau's highest point, the Ashka Krol flies cobalt blue banners, each embroidered with a clenched black fist.  The grand fortress's walls are hewn from dull black basalt, but obsidian knotwork inlay around the portcullis guarding the inner yard glints harshly in the daylight.  Lookouts along the embrasures watch the path leading toward the entrance, their glinting crossbows ever-trained on the scant flow of visitors and supplicants.
title: [Glaeve, The Path of Glory]
35135.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Squared stones tile a narrow walkway between two heaps of glittering spoils.  Chests full of gold, silver, and electrum coins spill their contents over marble busts wearing necklaces of emerald or ruby.  A garland of flowers made from gemstone flakes hangs from the edge of a portrait framed in widowwood.  Only cordons strung together by steel chains stand to dissuade clever hands and larcenous intentions.  A dark blue-grey banner marked with a trio of conjoined faces hangs from an archway leading north.
title: [Plunder Hall, Spoils]
35136.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Three immense masks of red-veined starveil loom over a raised dais of basalt at the hall's end, jeweled eyes staring intently down at an altar of scrimshawed whalebone.  Bars of gold and pieces of exotic jewelry are heaped at the altar's base, but the flat of it is occupied by a single ancient volume with pages edged in gold leaf.  Torches burn fitfully throughout the shrine, casting dancing shadows that take strange forms along the walls.
title: [Plunder Hall, Faces of Khar'ta]
35137.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Seafarers bedecked in a colorful collection of open-fronted coats, bandoliers, and tricorns gather below a low plinth that raises the guild's steward above the crowd.  Along the cold stone walls, heads of great pelagic beasts are mounted on boards of polished driftwood, their glass eyes regarding the ruckus impassively.  A bone statue of a sea serpent stands nearby, similarly disinterested in the affairs of the guild and its members.
title: [Reavers' Rest, Steward]
35138.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lush black velvet carpet with teal silk tassels mutes the clack of footsteps over the stones of the hall.  Along the walls hang purloined artworks, from bland elven watercolors to the bold oil paintings of Turamzzyrian virtuosos.  The sea of artistry parts for a paneled mahogany door, over which hangs a pair of crossed cutlasses forged from gold.
title: [Reavers' Rest, Hall]
35139.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lavish curtains of black spidersilk with glimmering silver brocade trim hang before the windows of the long stateroom, the style of which is somewhere between an office and a den.  Priceless tapestries and paintings hang on the wall behind an imposing maple desk with bright purpleheart and holly inlay, where a sextant and antique compass sit amid a scatter of papers and blunt-nibbed quills.  Part of a kraken arm, immaculately preserved, hangs on a mounting board above the door.
title: [Reavers' Rest, Stateroom]
35140.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Surly-looking cooks conspire to fill the air with the allure of exotic spices and roasting meats at the hallway's end.  Opulently carved wooden seats upholstered in stoutfoot wool sit around tables with semiprecious gemstone tesserae embedded in their surfaces, allowing guild officers the chance to hold court with their crews or compatriots while they dine.  A heavy door forged from adamantine guards the way into the guild's vault.
title: [Reavers' Rest, Officers' Mess]
35141.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Harsh golden light illuminates the chamber, blazing from torches that pepper the air with their smoke.  Much of the space is cordoned off by a half-wall of darkly stained mahogany, a wrought iron grate barring access to the riches beyond.  Treasure beyond an avaricious fever dream's ability to encompass is neatly catalogued and arranged in coffers behind the counter, from gold and silver coins to trade bars in exotic metals, along with a mind-boggling variety of furs and textiles.
title: [Reaver's Rest, Stateroom]
35142.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Banners hang from the walls of the jail, but their bright colors fail to bring much life to the corridors of dark stone, which are windowless and lit only by smoky, flickering torches.  Along one wall, a cell door is only the first of a dozen or so proceeding down the length of the building.  Shouts and sobs echo down the long hallway, which smells of moldering straw.
title: [Quartermaster's, Jail]
35143.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Icy wind screams through the open window of the cell, leaching away what tenuous warmth manages to seep through its heavy metal door.  The bars offer a tormenting glimpses of freedom in the streets outside, but also permit the clanking armor of the jail's enforcers to filter in as they patrol past.  There is no bed, only a small pile of straw, and dark red runes are smeared on the walls.
title: [Quartermaster's, Cell]
35144.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Garlands of dried herbs and flowers are hung at intervals across the cross-beamed ceiling, scenting the fur and pelt-covered walls nestled with long canvas cots.  A petrified wooden cabinet stands angled away from a small pot-bellied stove, the straw-lined container filled with rolls of fresh bandages and poultice-filled jars set beside a stone mortar and pestle.  Reed-woven hampers are set alongside the cots, filled to the brim with clean linens and wool blankets folded in neat stacks.
title: [Bitter Brews, Healer]
35145.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A stately bloodwood and ebony desk bars further passage into the manse, its surface a study in organized chaos.  Scrolls and ledgers form ordered piles, some so high that they look as if they must totter, and inkwells full of crimson fluid sit in precise rows along one edge.  The desk is positioned to watch the arched doors of a nearby office, over which a single stylized droplet is etched into the lintel.  Stairs ascend to a raised hallway overlooking the lower story.
title: [The Crimson House, Clerk]
35146.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dark red banners sway overhead, the velvet fabric gleaming faintly in the light of torches lining the huge hallway.  A high, vaulted ceiling of raw black timbers lends a cavernous quality to the space, turning the whispers and footsteps of passing guild members into distant echoes.  A crimson runner travels past dark copper statues of robed krolvin holding spheres, tomes, and daggers aloft.  Stairs descend to the lower story.
title: [The Crimson House, Hall]
35147.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls, paneled in rich mahogany, are lined with towering bookshelves that hold ancient vellum tomes bound in shadowy leather.  A large desk of blackened bloodwood sits at the center, its neatly ordered parchments pushed aside in favor of a single crimson orb atop a black ora stand.  Dimly lit by flickering candles in wrought-iron holders, the room is cast in a soft, ruddy glow, while the air is thick with the scent of burning incense.
title: [The Crimson House, Office]
35148.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rows of pews form a half-circle before a raised dais at the southernmost verge of the hall.  They part for a wide crimson runner that travels up a series of steps to a bloodstone altar, atop which sits a shallow bowl and a simple metal knife.  Behind the altar stands the copper statue of a tall, powerfully built krolvin with intense eyes, his arms crosshatched by scars.
title: [The Crimson House, Altar]
35149.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A single, small window near the ceiling lets in the barest hint of light, but niches carved into the dark stone walls hold squat candles augmenting the illumination.  Shelves cluttered with alembics, basalt mortar and pestles, and a number of crystals line the walls.  Sitting by itself on a dusty counter is a lichen-covered stone idol in the image of some sort of sea creature.
title: [The Crucible, Secondhand Goods]
35150.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bathed in the light of tall pillar candles burning in rough-edged nooks along the granite walls, an elaborate desk houses the accoutrements of the guild's clerk.  Quill pens from a number of bright-plumed birds sit near several pots holding inks of different colors.  The desk is carefully positioned to watch over a white ash door inlaid with a spill of golden coins, just beyond which stands a tall mosaic archway that marks the hallway's end.
title: [Traders' Hall, Clerk]
35151.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Along the walls of the meeting chamber, floor-to-ceiling panels of dark wood are graced with figures in gilt depicting exchanges of goods for coin and proud merchant vessels with their sails strained by favorable winds.  Circular in shape, the hall houses rows of seats in a raised gallery that overlooks a more intimate table ringed by grander chairs that are almost thrones in their own right.  Dark teal banners wave above, each embroidered with a set of golden scales loaded with coin.
title: [Traders' Hall, Meeting Chamber]
35152.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Ancient tapestries in the Ashrim style hang from the walls near the a white ash door leading into the guildmaster's office, both depicting battles between tall ships and sea monsters that look more the product of an evening's fancies than nature.  Sitting atop a desk of black walnut, a glimaerstone lamp with gnomish markings bathes the study in even light.  The wall opposite the doorway holds a timeworn ship's wheel that looks heavily stained with salt and smoothed by the touch of countless hands.
title: [Traders' Hall, Master's Office]
35153.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Opening into a long east-west corridor, the entry of the inn tumbles across the expansive lacquered pine flooring towards the semi-circular front desk.  Braziers of bronze and blackened iron occupy the corners, their burning contents providing illumination, warmth, and a spiced pungency to the air.  Gleaming yellow and white in the ambient light, an enormous woolly mammoth skull rests high on the wall behind the desk.
title: [The Raider's Take, Bell Desk]
35154.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Large glass-paned windows rimmed in frost gaze out upon the streets beyond and heavy wrought iron braziers fill the air with warmth and the scent of burning cedar and sandalwood.  Pelts adorn the walls, the refined pieces on display for visitors to admire and view as they pass down the corridor.  A set of steps leads into the open court where tables are arranged before a bar, while an archway leads to the inn's accommodations.
title: [The Raider's Take, Corridor]
35155.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Partially covered by the overhang of the inn's western and eastern roofs, the mead hall is filled with tables and benches.  Bronze braziers are arranged down the central aisle between tables, keeping the open space cozy and warm.  Pine needles are scattered about the ground, likely fallen from the crooked larch that bends over the inn.  Built against the southern wall of the inn, a long white and ebon bar is sheltered by the roof and offers a variety of fares, while various steps lead deeper into the structure.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, southwest, west
title: [The Raider's Take, Mead Hall]
35156.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bronze-bowled braziers dot the corridor, their brightly burning coals adding warmth to the air and providing a companionable glow that illuminates the russet-painted walls.  Carved support posts flank a set of descending steps steps to the west that lead into the open-air tavern, while opposite a grey-washed white oak door provides access to one of the inn's rooms.
title: [The Raider's Take, Corridor]
35157.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Filled with the scent of cedar and sandalwood, the small sleeping chamber is heated by a single bronze brazier that occupies the corner opposite a layered pile of sleeping furs.  Opposite the open white oak door is a grey, black, and white pebble mosaic that stretches from floor to ceiling, its greyscale hues reflected in the nearby driftwood chairs.  A small table in the northeastern corner has various sundries and a volcanic rock wash basin.
title: [The Raider's Take, Macaque Room]
35158.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: White stucco dominates the pine wall to the east, creating a stippled backdrop for a mural depicting a raid on the Shattered Coast.  Flickering light from a nearby brazier casts shadows upon the rafters where a variety of ancient boarding hooks dangle from wrought iron cleats.  Music and laughter trickles into the hallway from a set of descending steps and a nearby archway.
title: [The Raider's Take, Corridor]
35159.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Smoke rises from the damp cedar chips resting upon the hot coals of nearby braziers, perfuming the air as it dances in the moonlight that filters into the corridor from the west.  Carved posts support the overhang that stretches from the walls of the corridor and out into the open courtyard of the gathering hall, nearly touching the roof on the opposite side.  Built opposite each other, a grey-washed driftwood door stands open across the lacquered floor expanse from a set of descending steps.
title: [The Raider's Take, Corridor]
35160.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Scattered with orange-tinted pine needles, the hard-packed floor of the mead hall stretches to the south, culminating in a high privacy wall to the north where a variety of naval raiding objects are hung.  Bronze braziers keep the space warm, despite the cool air filtering down through the gap where the western and eastern roofs end.  Benches flank rectangular tables beneath the protective cover and ascending steps lead to the inn's guest rooms.
title: [The Raider's Take, Mead Hall]
35161.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

A grey-washed dark pine door occupies the western russet-stained wall and is open to the brazier-warmed air.

description: A braided rope net lies to the side of the trailway, frayed to the point of uselessness.  It is half buried in snowfall.  The path grows steeper as it climbs toward the base of the severe basalt cliffs towering over the beach.
title: [Grim Sands, Shale Path]
35167.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A colony of puffins with bright striped beaks have taken up residence in burrows amid the red grasses flanking the trail.  The little birds grunt to one another excitedly, several watching the trailway with wary black eyes.  A strong smell of fish lingers on the wind.
title: [Grim Sands, Puffin Colony]
35168.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Beside the shale path, a trio of dark stone cairns have been erected amid the red grasses.  There are no markers to identify their occupants, though one cairn has a corroded cutlass driven into the earth at its head.  Far up on the bluffs above, a lighthouse is silhouetted against the sky.
title: [Grim Sands, Cairns]
35169.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: As the shale path winds away from the beach, it climbs gently.  Past the high water line, the stark white of snow occludes the black of the sands.  Ruddy tundra grasses choke the spaces in between, clinging to the few hospitable niches in the ungentle terrain.
title: [Grim Sands, Shale Path]
35170.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Red tundra grasses dapple an embankment overlooking the shoreline.  Atop the bank stands a silvered pine shanty, a little ramshackle but stll standing despite the unforgiving elements of the shore.  Framed by the sheer black cliffs beyond, the structure looks all the more insignificant.
title: [Grim Sands, Shanty]
35171.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The shanty is no architectural marvel.  Its boards are uneven, letting in frigid moonlight and the bitter night wind.  The latter whistles through the small space, making pots hung over the fireplace rattle and setting nosegays of dried snowdrop and wintersweet swaying.  The flowers hold the smell of brine and fish at bay.  Beyond a small cot and an old rocking chair, there are few furnishings to commend the shack as an abode.
title: [Grim Sands, Shanty]
35172.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas
