Built into opposing walls, a lacquered beige door and a lacquered white door part the drapery and have a trio of brightly glowing globes directly above their pointed, cinquefoil frames.
title: [Inking Den, Annex Hallway]
29552.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Ivory drapes hang upon the walls, their overly long lower edges pooling upon the soft rug that stretches from wall to wall.  The drape's silken lengths are unfettered except where they are parted to provide egress through an ivory-edged crimson silk curtain.  A polished white birch counter sits in the center of the circular chamber, beneath the light of an enormous seaglass orb that is held aloft by a woven hemp basket.
title: [Annex, Booth]
29553.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Large clumps of marram grass sprout from the dunes on either side of a cultivated path as they slope toward the water.  Sea foam eddies and swirls among the rocks littering the beach, lapping at the edges of an overturned dinghy.  A rope-railed fishing pier extends from the sand out over the moonlit water, ending in a stack of crab traps leaning against a fishing shack.
title: [Fishing Pier]
29554.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Salt-stained fishing nets, in various stages of mending, cover the interior walls of the shack.  Woven throughout the lower section of each net is a series of lobsters, crabs, tuna, and other sea life, all masterfully recreated by a childlike hand.  A large piece of driftwood is mounted on the back wall and proudly displays a stuffed marlin.
title: [The Bait 'N Weight Shack]
29555.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rows of rust-hued brick line the walls of the repurposed entryway.  The spacious room is illuminated by several brass lanterns.  Set into the floor is a beautiful mosaic of colorful shells.  A silver filigree plaque hangs between a pair of small, dusty windows.  Placed just inside the room next to a curtained stone archway is a large notice board.
title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Vestibule]
29556.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This room is framed with dark blue walls that encircle a floor of tongue and groove ash planks.  A large bed fills the far corner, set with round, stone grey pillows, a heavy pewter and blue-green quilt, and a tasseled bedskirt of teal and brown velvet, creating a quaint semblance of a river running past thin river reeds.  On the wall directly across from the bed is a riverstone fireplace, with a hammered silver bucket of sticks atop the hearth, and beside it is an old, but handsome writing desk.
title: [Kelpie Beds, River Room]
29557.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sandy-hued, high pile carpeting covers the floor from one wall to the other, its weft and weave bestowing the likeness of a water-darkened beach beneath an azure sky ceiling.  Two hammocks woven from thick braids of linen and raw silk hang catercornered against the far wall, lashed to metal fixtures mounted on opposing sides of each wall joint.  Between them is a forked driftwood stand beneath an oval mirror with a lithe siren-cast bronze frame, and a painted mural adorns the walls from the head of each hammock to the door.
title: [Kelpie Beds, Sea Inlet Room]
29558.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Half-timbered walls painted white and black in repeating patterns rise up to an elegant gray slate roof.  Tucked amongst the slate are several airy gables and five red brick chimneys, thrusting upward from the estate like the fingers of a massive hand.  A cobbled carriage path leads from the street to five salt-and-pepper granite steps on which is centered a pair of massive monir doors banded with iron straps and decorated with rose head nails.  The western side of the estate appears to have been reduced to rubble.
title: [Estate, Approach]
29622.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The greatroom boasts square mahogany paneling that climbs gracefully to hand-hewn beams pegged with thick treenails.  At the center of the room, a variety of trophies surmount a mantel, three thickly tufted couches arcing about its carved granite fireplace.  A burnished brass and oak sideboard stretches along the rear wall beneath arched windows with leaded diamond panes that suffuse the room with sunlight.  The hallway to the west terminates in a pile of rubble.
meta: mapname:Kraken's Fall - Hand of the Arkati
title: [Estate, Greatroom]
29623.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Once a fully functional wing of the estate, all that remains are piles of rubble and a clearing littered with craters.  A small path wends through the rubble to the east meeting up with the hallway leading inside.  Inside the largest crater at the center, a sturdy steel workbench juts up obliquely amidst scorched jumbles of stone and mahogany.  A jagged crack zigzags through the rubble on the western rim of the large crater.
title: [Estate, Destruction]
29624.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lustrous white marble floors meet sky-blue walls which flow up to a dome of crystallized glass overhead.  Inset at the center of the ceiling is an ivory oculus carved with celestial symbols of Liabo.  Jagged tendrils of ivory jut forth from the oculus at haphazard angles, eternally grasping towards the sunlight.  Lor-accented bookcases carved to mimic trees line the walls, chaotically packed with tomes and scrolls.  Lor-inlaid double doors open to the west, and additional doors lead in various directions.

29625.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Smelling of dry hay and saddle soap, the stables are mostly unadorned.  A row of ten stalls with sliding wooden half-doors lines the far wall.  A massive pile of loose hay fills one end of the room, while the other sports a collection of saddles, tack, and one abused quintain.  Axe-hewn boards strewn with straw create a floor sturdy enough to stand the test of time against hooves and boots.
title: [Estate, Stables]
29626.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The temperature drops drastically upon entering the crypt, the air hanging damp and heavy.  Several rectangular openings filled with coffins line the walls and stretch down tunnels in all directions, barring the northern tunnel which ends suddenly with a smooth, stone slab.  The ground is exposed soil, pristine save for a few distinctly feline prints.  Mosses and lichens cling to the walls in myriad shades of green.  Looming in the center is an impressive oak desk carved with a lor tree.
title: [Estate, Crypt]
29627.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cavern is spacious, smelling of damp earth and saltwater.  Devoid of natural sunlight, a variety of bioluminescent mosses and lichens flourish underground, carpeting the sides and ground of the cave.  High above, a frothy blue-grey waterfall explodes from an opening, dumping into a deep pool teeming with life.  A crescent of agate and stone borders the rippling body of water.  At the center of the crescent is a stone pedestal and a chain-draped book with the remnants of a fused skeleton beneath.
title: [Estate, Cavern]
29628.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Featuring an aesthetic best described as "built by a captive shipwright," the dormitory is an upside-down ship's hull.  Wooden ribs arch overhead, supporting overlapping exterior clapboards.  Neatly made bunks with footlockers march down each side, interspersed with hammocks hanging from iron chains.  At the narrow bow, repurposed gangplanks rest on cannons, forming a makeshift table.  Whalebone candelabra cast dancing patterns onto the curving walls, illuminating a sprawling mural of a naval battle.
title: [Estate, Dormitory]
29629.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flowers envelop this covered patio, their sweet scent undercut slightly by the smell of fragrantly rich olive oil and the faint hint of ocean air.  A black and white tiled path encircles the area, centered by a raised stone platform surrounded by soft, unnaturally gleaming grass.  Along the path are a variety of cushioned leather couches and a small serving table, and a glass-paneled door traced with silvery lor leads back inside.

29630.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Contrasting with the rest of the manor, this room is constructed from white marble ashlar blocks and boasts only narrow windows, fortifying its position at the back of the house. Centered below it, a charcoal-filled brazier surmounts a hexagonal table strewn with maps on a crimson rug shot with golden embroidery. description: Waves batter the island's shores relentlessly, sending curtains of salty water skyward.  A low wall encircles the grounds as the only measure of safety against the rocks and watery depths below.  Four rectangular pillars, each roughly two feet high and bearing a distinct rune, form the corners of a sand garden.  In the center of the garden stands a flickering blue portal.  A rope and plank bridge connects to a rune-covered tower to the west, while an arching catwalk leads north to a gilded, dome-capped spire that glitters in the sunlight.
title: [The Weeping Isle]

description: Extending from the base of an arching catwalk, meticulous sand and crushed shell paths wind their way through lush, well-tended flowerbeds toward the islet's ivory spire.  A dome of shining gold caps the tall tower, glistening in the bright sunlight.  The smell of salt permeates the area anew with each successive crash of the ocean against the small island's rocky shores.  A set of ironwood double doors affixed with a small plaque leads inside the tall tower.

29774.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several potted ferns are scattered around the spacious entryway, and filtered sunlight slants in through tall stained glass windows. description: Smooth, pale stone walls encircle the spacious area, and evenly dispersed windows provide plenty of light. description: A map hangs above a bed situated near a window that runs the breadth of the stern, the view of the sea beyond superior to any painting hanging on the cherry-paneled walls of this well appointed cabin.  The nautical charts strewn across a table tell the ships history at sea, while the details are all recorded in the log books stacked on a chair.  A large sea chest occupies one corner, a lock securing its contents inside.

At the head of a table strewn with sea charts, a chair is afforded an uninterrupted view out of a glass-paned window spanning the width of the stern to the seas beyond.  A map and a stack of logbooks lie on the freshly swept deck at the foot of a bed.  A driftwood trunk packed with clothing and books sits open next to an ornate ivory and gold music stand.

Freshly made with clean linens, a bed stretches out beneath a clear glass-paned window at the rear of the cabin.  A lantern flickers atop a table stacked with books, empty teacups, and nautical charts.  A map is framed upon a cherry paneled wall above a chair, its seat occupied by a three-legged tabby cat.

Luxuriously appointed with plush carpets over a polished teak floor, the cabin is well lit by gilded brass sconces set with beeswax candles.  The curtains are drawn back from an expansive, glass-paned window, allowing the sunlight to spill across a bed and onto a table and a chair nearby.  A map is stuck to a teak-paneled wall by a dagger driven in almost to the hilt.

Sunlight filters through a large, glass-paned window, illuminating a map spread out on a table in the center of the cabin.  A logbook lies open on a bed near a chair piled with freshly laundered garments.  Nautical charts are tacked to the oak-paneled walls, all scribbled with illegible handwriting, one drawn with a giant sea monster.

Wrought iron lanterns sway overhead, the dancing flames casting light on a chair positioned behind a table, laden with charts, logbooks, and a map.  A bed is made up beneath an expansive window, the view interrupted by a dangling rope with bucket in hand to clean the glass panes.  A forgotten astrolabe lies near the door.
